pages.desc: Application-defined debug report callback function

items.name: flags
items.text:
pname:flags specifies the elink:VkDebugReportFlagBitsEXT that triggered
this callback.

items.name: objectType
items.text:
pname:objectType is a elink:VkDebugReportObjectTypeEXT value specifying
the type of object being used or created at the time the event was
triggered.

items.name: object
items.text:
pname:object is the object where the issue was detected.
If pname:objectType is ename:VK_DEBUG_REPORT_OBJECT_TYPE_UNKNOWN_EXT,
pname:object is undefined:.

items.name: location
items.text:
pname:location is a component (layer, driver, loader) defined value
specifying the _location_ of the trigger.
This is an optional: value.

items.name: messageCode
items.text:
pname:messageCode is a layer-defined value indicating what test
triggered this callback.

items.name: pLayerPrefix
items.text:
pname:pLayerPrefix is a null-terminated UTF-8 string that is an
abbreviation of the name of the component making the callback.
pname:pLayerPrefix is only valid for the duration of the callback.

items.name: pMessage
items.text:
pname:pMessage is a null-terminated UTF-8 string detailing the trigger
conditions.
pname:pMessage is only valid for the duration of the callback.

items.name: pUserData
items.text:
pname:pUserData is the application-defined user data pointer, equal to
the value of slink:VkDebugReportCallbackCreateInfoEXT::pname:pUserData
specified when the slink:VkDebugReportCallbackEXT object was created.

pages.name: PFN_vkDebugReportCallbackEXT

pages.desc: Application-defined debug messenger callback function

callback.

items.name: messageTypes
items.text:

elink:VkDebugUtilsMessageTypeFlagBitsEXT specifying which type of
event(s) triggered this callback.

items.name: pCallbackData
items.text:
pname:pCallbackData contains all the callback related data in the
slink:VkDebugUtilsMessengerCallbackDataEXT structure.

items.name: pUserData
items.text:
pname:pUserData is the application-defined user data pointer, equal to
the value of slink:VkDebugUtilsMessengerCreateInfoEXT::pname:pUserData
specified when the slink:VkDebugUtilsMessengerEXT object was created.

which reference acceleration structures)

which reference acceleration structures).

items.text:

accessible to ray shaders in the code:InstanceCustomIndexKHR built-in.

items.text:
pname:mask is an 8-bit visibility mask for the geometry.
The instance may: only be hit if `Cull Mask & instance.mask != 0`

items.text:
pname:instanceShaderBindingTableRecordOffset is a 24-bit offset used in
calculating the hit shader binding table index.

items.text:

items.name: accelerationStructureReference
items.text:
pname:accelerationStructureReference is either:
** a device address containing the value obtained from
flink:vkGetAccelerationStructureDeviceAddressKHR
or
flink:vkGetAccelerationStructureHandleNV
(used by device operations which reference acceleration structures) or,
** a slink:VkAccelerationStructureKHR object (used by host operations
which reference acceleration structures).

items.name: instanceCustomIndex
items.text:
pname:instanceCustomIndex and pname:mask occupy the same memory as if a
single code:uint32_t was specified in their place
** pname:instanceCustomIndex occupies the 24 least significant bits of
that memory
** pname:mask occupies the 8 most significant bits of that memory

items.name: instanceShaderBindingTableRecordOffset

pname:instanceShaderBindingTableRecordOffset and pname:flags occupy the
same memory as if a single code:uint32_t was specified in their place

significant bits of that memory

acceleration structure containing instance data referring to
bottom-level acceleration structures.

items.text:
ename:VK_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_TYPE_BOTTOM_LEVEL_KHR is a bottom-level
acceleration structure containing the AABBs or geometry to be
intersected.

items.text:
ename:VK_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_TYPE_GENERIC_KHR is an acceleration
structure whose type is determined at build time used for special
circumstances.
In these cases, the acceleration structure type is not known at creation
time, but must: be specified at build time as
micromap,
top, or bottom.

bottom-level acceleration structures.

pages.desc: Bitmask specifying memory access types that will participate in a memory dependency

items.name: VK_ACCESS_NONE
items.text: ename:VK_ACCESS_NONE specifies no accesses.

items.name: VK_ACCESS_MEMORY_READ_BIT
items.text:
ename:VK_ACCESS_MEMORY_READ_BIT specifies all read accesses.
It is always valid in any access mask, and is treated as equivalent to
setting all etext:READ access flags that are valid where it is used.

items.name: VK_ACCESS_MEMORY_WRITE_BIT
items.text:
ename:VK_ACCESS_MEMORY_WRITE_BIT specifies all write accesses.
It is always valid in any access mask, and is treated as equivalent to
setting all etext:WRITE access flags that are valid where it is used.

items.name: VK_ACCESS_INDIRECT_COMMAND_READ_BIT
items.text:
ename:VK_ACCESS_INDIRECT_COMMAND_READ_BIT specifies read access to
indirect command data read as part of an indirect
build,
trace,
drawing or dispatching command.
Such access occurs in the ename:VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_DRAW_INDIRECT_BIT
pipeline stage.

items.name: VK_ACCESS_INDEX_READ_BIT
items.text:
ename:VK_ACCESS_INDEX_READ_BIT specifies read access to an index buffer
as part of an indexed drawing command, bound by
flink:vkCmdBindIndexBuffer2 and
flink:vkCmdBindIndexBuffer.
Such access occurs in the ename:VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_VERTEX_INPUT_BIT
pipeline stage.

items.name: VK_ACCESS_VERTEX_ATTRIBUTE_READ_BIT
items.text:
ename:VK_ACCESS_VERTEX_ATTRIBUTE_READ_BIT specifies read access to a
vertex buffer as part of a drawing command, bound by
flink:vkCmdBindVertexBuffers.
Such access occurs in the ename:VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_VERTEX_INPUT_BIT
pipeline stage.

items.name: VK_ACCESS_UNIFORM_READ_BIT
items.text:
ename:VK_ACCESS_UNIFORM_READ_BIT specifies read access to a
<<descriptors-uniformbuffer, uniform buffer>> in any shader pipeline
stage.

items.name: VK_ACCESS_INPUT_ATTACHMENT_READ_BIT
items.text:
ename:VK_ACCESS_INPUT_ATTACHMENT_READ_BIT specifies read access to an
<<renderpass, input attachment>> within a render pass during
subpass shading or
fragment shading.
Such access occurs in the
ename:VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_SUBPASS_SHADER_BIT_HUAWEI or
ename:VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_FRAGMENT_SHADER_BIT pipeline stage.

items.name: VK_ACCESS_SHADER_READ_BIT
items.text:
ename:VK_ACCESS_SHADER_READ_BIT specifies read access to a
<<descriptors-uniformtexelbuffer, uniform texel buffer>>,
<<descriptors-sampledimage, sampled image>>,
<<descriptors-storagebuffer, storage buffer>>,
<<descriptors-physical-storage-buffer, physical storage buffer>>,
<<shader-binding-table, shader binding table>>,
<<descriptors-storagetensor,storage tensor>>,
<<descriptors-storagetexelbuffer, storage texel buffer>>, or
<<descriptors-storageimage, storage image>> in any shader pipeline
stage.

items.name: VK_ACCESS_SHADER_WRITE_BIT
items.text:
ename:VK_ACCESS_SHADER_WRITE_BIT specifies write access to a
<<descriptors-storagebuffer, storage buffer>>,
<<descriptors-physical-storage-buffer, physical storage buffer>>,
<<descriptors-storagetensor,storage tensor>>,
<<descriptors-storagetexelbuffer, storage texel buffer>>, or
<<descriptors-storageimage, storage image>> in any shader pipeline
stage.

items.name: VK_ACCESS_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_READ_BIT
items.text:
ename:VK_ACCESS_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_READ_BIT specifies read access to a
<<renderpass, color attachment>>, such as via
<<framebuffer-blending, blending>> (other than
<<framebuffer-blend-advanced, advanced blend operations>>),
<<framebuffer-logicop, logic operations>> or certain
<<renderpass-load-operations, render pass load operations>> in the
ename:VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OUTPUT_BIT pipeline stage or
via <<fragops-shader-tileimage-reads, fragment shader tile image reads>>
in the ename:VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_FRAGMENT_SHADER_BIT pipeline stage.

items.name: VK_ACCESS_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_WRITE_BIT
items.text:
ename:VK_ACCESS_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_WRITE_BIT specifies write access to a
<<renderpass, color attachment>> during a <<renderpass, render pass>> or
via certain render pass <<renderpass-load-operations, load>>,
<<renderpass-store-operations, store>>, and
<<renderpass-resolve-operations, multisample resolve>> operations.
This includes <<renderpass-resolve-operations, multisample resolve>>
operations for depth/stencil resolve attachments.
Such access occurs in the
ename:VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OUTPUT_BIT pipeline stage.

items.name: VK_ACCESS_DEPTH_STENCIL_ATTACHMENT_READ_BIT
items.text:
ename:VK_ACCESS_DEPTH_STENCIL_ATTACHMENT_READ_BIT specifies read access
to a <<renderpass, depth/stencil attachment>>, via <<fragops-ds-state,
depth or stencil operations>> or certain
<<renderpass-load-operations, render pass load operations>> in the
ename:VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_EARLY_FRAGMENT_TESTS_BIT or
ename:VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_LATE_FRAGMENT_TESTS_BIT pipeline stages or via
<<fragops-shader-tileimage-reads, fragment shader tile image reads>> in
the ename:VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_FRAGMENT_SHADER_BIT pipeline stage.

items.name: VK_ACCESS_DEPTH_STENCIL_ATTACHMENT_WRITE_BIT
items.text:
ename:VK_ACCESS_DEPTH_STENCIL_ATTACHMENT_WRITE_BIT specifies write
access to a <<renderpass, depth/stencil attachment>>, via
<<fragops-ds-state, depth or stencil operations>> or certain render pass
<<renderpass-load-operations, load>> and <<renderpass-store-operations,
store>> operations.
Such access occurs in the
ename:VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_EARLY_FRAGMENT_TESTS_BIT or
ename:VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_LATE_FRAGMENT_TESTS_BIT pipeline stages.

items.name: VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_READ_BIT
items.text:
ename:VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_READ_BIT specifies read access to an
image, tensor,
or buffer in a <<copies, copy>> operation.
Such access occurs in the ename:VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_ALL_TRANSFER_BIT
pipeline stage.

items.name: VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_WRITE_BIT
items.text:
ename:VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_WRITE_BIT specifies write access to an
image, tensor,
or buffer in a <<clears, clear>> or <<copies, copy>> operation.
Such access occurs in the ename:VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_ALL_TRANSFER_BIT
pipeline stage.

items.name: VK_ACCESS_HOST_READ_BIT
items.text:
ename:VK_ACCESS_HOST_READ_BIT specifies read access by a host operation.
Accesses of this type are not performed through a resource, but directly
on memory.
Such access occurs in the ename:VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_HOST_BIT pipeline
stage.

items.name: VK_ACCESS_HOST_WRITE_BIT
items.text:
ename:VK_ACCESS_HOST_WRITE_BIT specifies write access by a host
operation.
Accesses of this type are not performed through a resource, but directly
on memory.
Such access occurs in the ename:VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_HOST_BIT pipeline
stage.

items.name: VK_ACCESS_CONDITIONAL_RENDERING_READ_BIT_EXT
items.text:
ename:VK_ACCESS_CONDITIONAL_RENDERING_READ_BIT_EXT specifies read access
to a predicate as part of conditional rendering.
Such access occurs in the
ename:VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_CONDITIONAL_RENDERING_BIT_EXT pipeline stage.

items.name: VK_ACCESS_TRANSFORM_FEEDBACK_WRITE_BIT_EXT
items.text:
ename:VK_ACCESS_TRANSFORM_FEEDBACK_WRITE_BIT_EXT specifies write access
to a transform feedback buffer made when transform feedback is active.
Such access occurs in the
ename:VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TRANSFORM_FEEDBACK_BIT_EXT pipeline stage.

items.name: VK_ACCESS_TRANSFORM_FEEDBACK_COUNTER_READ_BIT_EXT
items.text:
ename:VK_ACCESS_TRANSFORM_FEEDBACK_COUNTER_READ_BIT_EXT specifies read
access to a transform feedback counter buffer which is read when
fname:vkCmdBeginTransformFeedbackEXT executes.
Such access occurs in the
ename:VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TRANSFORM_FEEDBACK_BIT_EXT pipeline stage.

items.name: VK_ACCESS_TRANSFORM_FEEDBACK_COUNTER_WRITE_BIT_EXT
items.text:
ename:VK_ACCESS_TRANSFORM_FEEDBACK_COUNTER_WRITE_BIT_EXT specifies write
access to a transform feedback counter buffer which is written when
fname:vkCmdEndTransformFeedbackEXT executes.
Such access occurs in the
ename:VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TRANSFORM_FEEDBACK_BIT_EXT pipeline stage.

items.name: VK_ACCESS_COMMAND_PREPROCESS_READ_BIT_NV
items.text:
ename:VK_ACCESS_COMMAND_PREPROCESS_READ_BIT_NV specifies reads from
buffer inputs to flink:vkCmdPreprocessGeneratedCommandsNV.
Such access occurs in the
ename:VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_COMMAND_PREPROCESS_BIT_NV pipeline stage.

items.name: VK_ACCESS_COMMAND_PREPROCESS_WRITE_BIT_NV
items.text:
ename:VK_ACCESS_COMMAND_PREPROCESS_WRITE_BIT_NV specifies writes to the
target command buffer preprocess outputs in
flink:vkCmdPreprocessGeneratedCommandsNV.
Such access occurs in the
ename:VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_COMMAND_PREPROCESS_BIT_NV pipeline stage.

items.name: VK_ACCESS_COMMAND_PREPROCESS_READ_BIT_EXT
items.text:
ename:VK_ACCESS_COMMAND_PREPROCESS_READ_BIT_EXT specifies reads from
buffer inputs to flink:vkCmdPreprocessGeneratedCommandsEXT.
Such access occurs in the
ename:VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_COMMAND_PREPROCESS_BIT_EXT pipeline stage.

items.name: VK_ACCESS_COMMAND_PREPROCESS_WRITE_BIT_EXT
items.text:
ename:VK_ACCESS_COMMAND_PREPROCESS_WRITE_BIT_EXT specifies writes to the
target command buffer preprocess outputs in
flink:vkCmdPreprocessGeneratedCommandsEXT.
Such access occurs in the
ename:VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_COMMAND_PREPROCESS_BIT_EXT pipeline stage.

items.name: VK_ACCESS_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_READ_NONCOHERENT_BIT_EXT
items.text:
ename:VK_ACCESS_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_READ_NONCOHERENT_BIT_EXT specifies read
access to <<renderpass, color attachments>>, including
<<framebuffer-blend-advanced,advanced blend operations>>.
Such access occurs in the
ename:VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OUTPUT_BIT pipeline stage.

items.name: VK_ACCESS_2_INVOCATION_MASK_READ_BIT_HUAWEI
items.text:
ename:VK_ACCESS_2_INVOCATION_MASK_READ_BIT_HUAWEI specifies read access
to an invocation mask image in the
ename:VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_INVOCATION_MASK_BIT_HUAWEI pipeline stage.

items.name: VK_ACCESS_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_READ_BIT_KHR
items.text:
ename:VK_ACCESS_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_READ_BIT_KHR specifies read
access to an acceleration structure as part of a trace, build, or copy
command, or to an <<acceleration-structure-scratch, acceleration
structure scratch buffer>> as part of a build command.
Such access occurs in the
ename:VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_RAY_TRACING_SHADER_BIT_KHR pipeline stage or
ename:VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_BUILD_BIT_KHR pipeline
stage.

items.name: VK_ACCESS_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_WRITE_BIT_KHR
items.text:
ename:VK_ACCESS_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_WRITE_BIT_KHR specifies write
access to an acceleration structure or <<acceleration-structure-scratch,
acceleration structure scratch buffer>> as part of a build or copy
command.
Such access occurs in the
ename:VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_BUILD_BIT_KHR pipeline
stage.

items.name: VK_ACCESS_FRAGMENT_DENSITY_MAP_READ_BIT_EXT
items.text:
ename:VK_ACCESS_FRAGMENT_DENSITY_MAP_READ_BIT_EXT specifies read access
to a <<renderpass-fragmentdensitymapattachment, fragment density map
attachment>> during dynamic <<fragmentdensitymapops, fragment density
map operations>> Such access occurs in the
ename:VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_FRAGMENT_DENSITY_PROCESS_BIT_EXT pipeline stage.

items.name: VK_ACCESS_FRAGMENT_SHADING_RATE_ATTACHMENT_READ_BIT_KHR
items.text:
ename:VK_ACCESS_FRAGMENT_SHADING_RATE_ATTACHMENT_READ_BIT_KHR specifies
read access to a fragment shading rate attachment during rasterization.
Such access occurs in the
ename:VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_FRAGMENT_SHADING_RATE_ATTACHMENT_BIT_KHR
pipeline stage.

items.name: VK_ACCESS_SHADING_RATE_IMAGE_READ_BIT_NV
items.text:
ename:VK_ACCESS_SHADING_RATE_IMAGE_READ_BIT_NV specifies read access to
a shading rate image during rasterization.
Such access occurs in the
ename:VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_SHADING_RATE_IMAGE_BIT_NV pipeline stage.
It is equivalent to
ename:VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_FRAGMENT_SHADING_RATE_ATTACHMENT_BIT_KHR.

items.name: VK_ACCESS_2_MEMORY_READ_BIT
items.text:
ename:VK_ACCESS_2_MEMORY_READ_BIT specifies all read accesses.
It is always valid in any access mask, and is treated as equivalent to
setting all etext:READ access flags that are valid where it is used.

ename:VK_ACCESS_2_MEMORY_WRITE_BIT specifies all write accesses.
It is always valid in any access mask, and is treated as equivalent to

items.name: VK_ACCESS_2_INDIRECT_COMMAND_READ_BIT
items.text:
ename:VK_ACCESS_2_INDIRECT_COMMAND_READ_BIT specifies read access to
command data read from indirect buffers as part of an indirect
build,
trace,
drawing or dispatch command.
Such access occurs in the ename:VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_DRAW_INDIRECT_BIT
pipeline stage.
It also specifies read access to command data read from indirect buffers
as part of a copy command with access occurring in the
ename:VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_COPY_INDIRECT_BIT_KHR pipeline stage.

items.name: VK_ACCESS_2_INDEX_READ_BIT
items.text:
ename:VK_ACCESS_2_INDEX_READ_BIT specifies read access to an index
buffer as part of an indexed drawing command, bound by
flink:vkCmdBindIndexBuffer2 and
flink:vkCmdBindIndexBuffer.
Such access occurs in the ename:VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_INDEX_INPUT_BIT
pipeline stage.

items.name: VK_ACCESS_2_VERTEX_ATTRIBUTE_READ_BIT
items.text:
ename:VK_ACCESS_2_VERTEX_ATTRIBUTE_READ_BIT specifies read access to a
vertex buffer as part of a drawing command, bound by
flink:vkCmdBindVertexBuffers.
Such access occurs in the
ename:VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_VERTEX_ATTRIBUTE_INPUT_BIT pipeline stage.

items.name: VK_ACCESS_2_UNIFORM_READ_BIT
items.text:
ename:VK_ACCESS_2_UNIFORM_READ_BIT specifies read access to a
<<descriptors-uniformbuffer, uniform buffer>> in any shader pipeline
stage.

items.name: VK_ACCESS_2_INPUT_ATTACHMENT_READ_BIT
items.text:
ename:VK_ACCESS_2_INPUT_ATTACHMENT_READ_BIT specifies read access to an
<<renderpass, input attachment>> within a render pass during
subpass shading or
fragment shading.
Such access occurs in the
ename:VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_SUBPASS_SHADER_BIT_HUAWEI or
ename:VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_FRAGMENT_SHADER_BIT pipeline stage.

items.name: VK_ACCESS_2_SHADER_SAMPLED_READ_BIT
items.text:
ename:VK_ACCESS_2_SHADER_SAMPLED_READ_BIT specifies read access to a
<<descriptors-uniformtexelbuffer, uniform texel buffer>> or
<<descriptors-sampledimage, sampled image>> in any shader pipeline
stage.

items.name: VK_ACCESS_2_SHADER_STORAGE_READ_BIT
items.text:
ename:VK_ACCESS_2_SHADER_STORAGE_READ_BIT specifies read access to a
<<descriptors-storagebuffer, storage buffer>>,
<<descriptors-physical-storage-buffer, physical storage buffer>>,
<<descriptors-storagetexelbuffer, storage texel buffer>>, or
<<descriptors-storageimage, storage image>> in any shader pipeline
stage.

items.name: VK_ACCESS_2_SHADER_BINDING_TABLE_READ_BIT_KHR
items.text:
ename:VK_ACCESS_2_SHADER_BINDING_TABLE_READ_BIT_KHR specifies read
access to a <<shader-binding-table, shader binding table>> in any shader
pipeline stage.

items.name: VK_ACCESS_2_SHADER_READ_BIT
items.text:
ename:VK_ACCESS_2_SHADER_READ_BIT
is equivalent to the logical OR of:
** ename:VK_ACCESS_2_SHADER_SAMPLED_READ_BIT
** ename:VK_ACCESS_2_SHADER_STORAGE_READ_BIT
** ename:VK_ACCESS_2_SHADER_BINDING_TABLE_READ_BIT_KHR
** ename:VK_ACCESS_2_SHADER_TILE_ATTACHMENT_READ_BIT_QCOM

items.name: VK_ACCESS_2_SHADER_STORAGE_WRITE_BIT
items.text:
ename:VK_ACCESS_2_SHADER_STORAGE_WRITE_BIT specifies write access to a
<<descriptors-storagebuffer, storage buffer>>,
<<descriptors-physical-storage-buffer, physical storage buffer>>,
<<descriptors-storagetexelbuffer, storage texel buffer>>, or
<<descriptors-storageimage, storage image>> in any shader pipeline
stage.

items.name: VK_ACCESS_2_SHADER_WRITE_BIT
items.text:
ename:VK_ACCESS_2_SHADER_WRITE_BIT is equivalent to
ename:VK_ACCESS_2_SHADER_STORAGE_WRITE_BIT.

items.name: VK_ACCESS_2_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_READ_BIT
items.text:
ename:VK_ACCESS_2_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_READ_BIT specifies read access to a
<<renderpass, color attachment>>, such as via
<<framebuffer-blending, blending>> (other than
<<framebuffer-blend-advanced, advanced blend operations>>),
<<framebuffer-logicop, logic operations>> or certain
<<renderpass-load-operations, render pass load operations>> in the
ename:VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OUTPUT_BIT pipeline stage or
via <<fragops-shader-tileimage-reads, fragment shader tile image reads>>
in the ename:VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_FRAGMENT_SHADER_BIT pipeline stage.

items.name: VK_ACCESS_2_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_WRITE_BIT
items.text:
ename:VK_ACCESS_2_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_WRITE_BIT specifies write access to a
<<renderpass, color attachment>> during a <<renderpass, render pass>> or
via certain render pass <<renderpass-load-operations, load>>,
<<renderpass-store-operations, store>>, and
<<renderpass-resolve-operations, multisample resolve>> operations.
This includes <<renderpass-resolve-operations, multisample resolve>>
operations for depth/stencil resolve attachments.
Such access occurs in the
ename:VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OUTPUT_BIT pipeline stage.

items.name: VK_ACCESS_2_DEPTH_STENCIL_ATTACHMENT_READ_BIT
items.text:
ename:VK_ACCESS_2_DEPTH_STENCIL_ATTACHMENT_READ_BIT specifies read
access to a <<renderpass, depth/stencil attachment>>, via
<<fragops-ds-state, depth or stencil operations>> or certain
<<renderpass-load-operations, render pass load operations>> in the
ename:VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_EARLY_FRAGMENT_TESTS_BIT or
ename:VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_LATE_FRAGMENT_TESTS_BIT pipeline stages or via
<<fragops-shader-tileimage-reads, fragment shader tile image reads>> in
the ename:VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_FRAGMENT_SHADER_BIT pipeline stage.

items.name: VK_ACCESS_2_DEPTH_STENCIL_ATTACHMENT_WRITE_BIT
items.text:
ename:VK_ACCESS_2_DEPTH_STENCIL_ATTACHMENT_WRITE_BIT specifies write
access to a <<renderpass, depth/stencil attachment>>, via
<<fragops-ds-state, depth or stencil operations>> or certain render pass
<<renderpass-load-operations, load>> and <<renderpass-store-operations,
store>> operations.
Such access occurs in the
ename:VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_EARLY_FRAGMENT_TESTS_BIT or
ename:VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_LATE_FRAGMENT_TESTS_BIT pipeline stages.

items.name: VK_ACCESS_2_TRANSFER_READ_BIT
items.text:
ename:VK_ACCESS_2_TRANSFER_READ_BIT specifies read access to an image or
buffer in a <<copies, copy>> operation.
Such access occurs in the ename:VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_COPY_BIT,
ename:VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_BLIT_BIT, or
ename:VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_RESOLVE_BIT pipeline stages.

items.name: VK_ACCESS_2_TRANSFER_WRITE_BIT
items.text:
ename:VK_ACCESS_2_TRANSFER_WRITE_BIT specifies write access to an image
or buffer in a <<clears, clear>> or <<copies, copy>> operation.
Such access occurs in the ename:VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_COPY_BIT,
ename:VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_BLIT_BIT, ename:VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_CLEAR_BIT,
or ename:VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_RESOLVE_BIT pipeline stages.

items.name: VK_ACCESS_2_HOST_READ_BIT
items.text:
ename:VK_ACCESS_2_HOST_READ_BIT specifies read access by a host
operation.
Accesses of this type are not performed through a resource, but directly
on memory.
Such access occurs in the ename:VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_HOST_BIT pipeline
stage.

items.name: VK_ACCESS_2_HOST_WRITE_BIT
items.text:
ename:VK_ACCESS_2_HOST_WRITE_BIT specifies write access by a host
operation.
Accesses of this type are not performed through a resource, but directly
on memory.
Such access occurs in the ename:VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_HOST_BIT pipeline
stage.

items.name: VK_ACCESS_2_CONDITIONAL_RENDERING_READ_BIT_EXT
items.text:
ename:VK_ACCESS_2_CONDITIONAL_RENDERING_READ_BIT_EXT specifies read
access to a predicate as part of conditional rendering.
Such access occurs in the
ename:VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_CONDITIONAL_RENDERING_BIT_EXT pipeline stage.

items.name: VK_ACCESS_2_TRANSFORM_FEEDBACK_WRITE_BIT_EXT
items.text:
ename:VK_ACCESS_2_TRANSFORM_FEEDBACK_WRITE_BIT_EXT specifies write
access to a transform feedback buffer made when transform feedback is
active.
Such access occurs in the
ename:VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_TRANSFORM_FEEDBACK_BIT_EXT pipeline stage.

items.name: VK_ACCESS_2_TRANSFORM_FEEDBACK_COUNTER_READ_BIT_EXT
items.text:
ename:VK_ACCESS_2_TRANSFORM_FEEDBACK_COUNTER_READ_BIT_EXT specifies read
access to a transform feedback counter buffer which is read when
flink:vkCmdBeginTransformFeedbackEXT executes.
Such access occurs in the
ename:VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_TRANSFORM_FEEDBACK_BIT_EXT pipeline stage.

items.name: VK_ACCESS_2_TRANSFORM_FEEDBACK_COUNTER_WRITE_BIT_EXT
items.text:
ename:VK_ACCESS_2_TRANSFORM_FEEDBACK_COUNTER_WRITE_BIT_EXT specifies
write access to a transform feedback counter buffer which is written
when flink:vkCmdEndTransformFeedbackEXT executes.
Such access occurs in the
ename:VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_TRANSFORM_FEEDBACK_BIT_EXT pipeline stage.

items.name: VK_ACCESS_2_COMMAND_PREPROCESS_READ_BIT_NV
items.text:
ename:VK_ACCESS_2_COMMAND_PREPROCESS_READ_BIT_NV specifies reads from
buffer inputs to flink:vkCmdPreprocessGeneratedCommandsNV.
Such access occurs in the
ename:VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_COMMAND_PREPROCESS_BIT_NV pipeline stage.

items.name: VK_ACCESS_2_COMMAND_PREPROCESS_WRITE_BIT_NV
items.text:
ename:VK_ACCESS_2_COMMAND_PREPROCESS_WRITE_BIT_NV specifies writes to
the target command buffer preprocess outputs.
Such access occurs in the
ename:VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_COMMAND_PREPROCESS_BIT_NV pipeline stage.

items.name: VK_ACCESS_2_COMMAND_PREPROCESS_READ_BIT_EXT
items.text:
ename:VK_ACCESS_2_COMMAND_PREPROCESS_READ_BIT_EXT specifies reads from
buffer inputs to flink:vkCmdPreprocessGeneratedCommandsEXT.
Such access occurs in the
ename:VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_COMMAND_PREPROCESS_BIT_EXT pipeline stage.

items.name: VK_ACCESS_2_COMMAND_PREPROCESS_WRITE_BIT_EXT
items.text:
ename:VK_ACCESS_2_COMMAND_PREPROCESS_WRITE_BIT_EXT specifies writes to
the target command buffer preprocess outputs.
Such access occurs in the
ename:VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_COMMAND_PREPROCESS_BIT_EXT pipeline stage.

items.name: VK_ACCESS_2_MEMORY_DECOMPRESSION_READ_BIT_EXT
items.text:
ename:VK_ACCESS_2_MEMORY_DECOMPRESSION_READ_BIT_EXT specifies read
access to memory in decompression commands
flink:vkCmdDecompressMemoryEXT and
flink:vkCmdDecompressMemoryIndirectCountEXT.
Such access occurs in
ename:VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_MEMORY_DECOMPRESSION_BIT_EXT pipeline stage.

items.name: VK_ACCESS_2_MEMORY_DECOMPRESSION_WRITE_BIT_EXT
items.text:
ename:VK_ACCESS_2_MEMORY_DECOMPRESSION_WRITE_BIT_EXT specifies write
access to memory in decompression commands
flink:vkCmdDecompressMemoryEXT and
flink:vkCmdDecompressMemoryIndirectCountEXT.
Such access occurs in
ename:VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_MEMORY_DECOMPRESSION_BIT_EXT pipeline stage.

items.name: VK_ACCESS_2_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_READ_NONCOHERENT_BIT_EXT
items.text:
ename:VK_ACCESS_2_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_READ_NONCOHERENT_BIT_EXT specifies
read access to <<renderpass, color attachments>>, including
<<framebuffer-blend-advanced,advanced blend operations>>.
Such access occurs in the
ename:VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OUTPUT_BIT pipeline stage.

items.name: VK_ACCESS_2_INVOCATION_MASK_READ_BIT_HUAWEI
items.text:
ename:VK_ACCESS_2_INVOCATION_MASK_READ_BIT_HUAWEI specifies read access
to an invocation mask image in the
ename:VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_INVOCATION_MASK_BIT_HUAWEI pipeline stage.

items.name: VK_ACCESS_2_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_READ_BIT_KHR
items.text:
ename:VK_ACCESS_2_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_READ_BIT_KHR specifies read
access to an acceleration structure as part of a trace, build, or copy
command, or to an <<acceleration-structure-scratch, acceleration
structure scratch buffer>> as part of a build command.
Such access occurs in the
ename:VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_RAY_TRACING_SHADER_BIT_KHR pipeline stage or
ename:VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_BUILD_BIT_KHR pipeline
stage.

items.name: VK_ACCESS_2_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_WRITE_BIT_KHR
items.text:
ename:VK_ACCESS_2_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_WRITE_BIT_KHR specifies write
access to an acceleration structure or <<acceleration-structure-scratch,
acceleration structure scratch buffer>> as part of a build or copy
command.
Such access occurs in the
ename:VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_BUILD_BIT_KHR pipeline
stage.

items.name: VK_ACCESS_2_FRAGMENT_DENSITY_MAP_READ_BIT_EXT
items.text:
ename:VK_ACCESS_2_FRAGMENT_DENSITY_MAP_READ_BIT_EXT specifies read
access to a <<renderpass-fragmentdensitymapattachment, fragment density
map attachment>> during dynamic <<fragmentdensitymapops, fragment
density map operations>>.
Such access occurs in the
ename:VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_FRAGMENT_DENSITY_PROCESS_BIT_EXT pipeline
stage.

items.name: VK_ACCESS_2_FRAGMENT_SHADING_RATE_ATTACHMENT_READ_BIT_KHR
items.text:
ename:VK_ACCESS_2_FRAGMENT_SHADING_RATE_ATTACHMENT_READ_BIT_KHR
specifies read access to a fragment shading rate attachment during
rasterization.
Such access occurs in the
ename:VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_FRAGMENT_SHADING_RATE_ATTACHMENT_BIT_KHR
pipeline stage.

items.name: VK_ACCESS_2_SHADING_RATE_IMAGE_READ_BIT_NV
items.text:
ename:VK_ACCESS_2_SHADING_RATE_IMAGE_READ_BIT_NV specifies read access
to a shading rate image during rasterization.
Such access occurs in the
ename:VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_SHADING_RATE_IMAGE_BIT_NV pipeline stage.
It is equivalent to
ename:VK_ACCESS_2_FRAGMENT_SHADING_RATE_ATTACHMENT_READ_BIT_KHR.

items.name: VK_ACCESS_2_VIDEO_DECODE_READ_BIT_KHR
items.text:
ename:VK_ACCESS_2_VIDEO_DECODE_READ_BIT_KHR specifies read access to an
image or buffer resource in a <<video-decode-operations, video decode
operation>>.
Such access occurs in the ename:VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_VIDEO_DECODE_BIT_KHR
pipeline stage.

items.name: VK_ACCESS_2_VIDEO_DECODE_WRITE_BIT_KHR
items.text:
ename:VK_ACCESS_2_VIDEO_DECODE_WRITE_BIT_KHR specifies write access to
an image or buffer resource in a <<video-decode-operations, video decode
operation>>.
Such access occurs in the ename:VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_VIDEO_DECODE_BIT_KHR
pipeline stage.

items.name: VK_ACCESS_2_VIDEO_ENCODE_READ_BIT_KHR
items.text:
ename:VK_ACCESS_2_VIDEO_ENCODE_READ_BIT_KHR specifies read access to an
image or buffer resource in a <<video-encode-operations, video encode
operation>>.
Such access occurs in the ename:VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_VIDEO_ENCODE_BIT_KHR
pipeline stage.

items.name: VK_ACCESS_2_VIDEO_ENCODE_WRITE_BIT_KHR
items.text:
ename:VK_ACCESS_2_VIDEO_ENCODE_WRITE_BIT_KHR specifies write access to
an image or buffer resource in a <<video-encode-operations, video encode
operation>>.
Such access occurs in the ename:VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_VIDEO_ENCODE_BIT_KHR
pipeline stage.

items.name: VK_ACCESS_2_DESCRIPTOR_BUFFER_READ_BIT_EXT
items.text:
ename:VK_ACCESS_2_DESCRIPTOR_BUFFER_READ_BIT_EXT specifies read access
to a <<descriptorbuffers, descriptor buffer>> in any shader pipeline
stage.

items.name: VK_ACCESS_2_OPTICAL_FLOW_READ_BIT_NV
items.text:
ename:VK_ACCESS_2_OPTICAL_FLOW_READ_BIT_NV specifies read access to an
image or buffer resource as part of a <<opticalflow-operations, optical
flow operation>>.
Such access occurs in the ename:VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_OPTICAL_FLOW_BIT_NV
pipeline stage.

items.name: VK_ACCESS_2_OPTICAL_FLOW_WRITE_BIT_NV
items.text:
ename:VK_ACCESS_2_OPTICAL_FLOW_WRITE_BIT_NV specifies write access to an
image or buffer resource as part of a <<opticalflow-operations, optical
flow operation>>.
Such access occurs in the ename:VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_OPTICAL_FLOW_BIT_NV
pipeline stage.

items.name: VK_ACCESS_2_MICROMAP_WRITE_BIT_EXT
items.text:
ename:VK_ACCESS_2_MICROMAP_WRITE_BIT_EXT specifies write access to a
micromap object.
Such access occurs in the
ename:VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_MICROMAP_BUILD_BIT_EXT pipeline stage.

items.name: VK_ACCESS_2_MICROMAP_READ_BIT_EXT
items.text:
ename:VK_ACCESS_2_MICROMAP_READ_BIT_EXT specifies read access to a
micromap object.
Such access occurs in the
ename:VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_MICROMAP_BUILD_BIT_EXT and
ename:VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_BUILD_BIT_KHR pipeline
stages.

items.name: VK_ACCESS_2_SHADER_TILE_ATTACHMENT_READ_BIT_QCOM
items.text:
ename:VK_ACCESS_2_SHADER_TILE_ATTACHMENT_READ_BIT_QCOM specifies read
access to a <<renderpass-tile-shading-attachment-access, tile
attachment>>.
Such access occurs in the ename:VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_FRAGMENT_SHADER_BIT
or ename:VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_COMPUTE_SHADER_BIT pipeline stages.

items.name: VK_ACCESS_2_SHADER_TILE_ATTACHMENT_WRITE_BIT_QCOM
items.text:
ename:VK_ACCESS_2_SHADER_TILE_ATTACHMENT_WRITE_BIT_QCOM specifies write
access to a <<renderpass-tile-shading-attachment-access, tile
attachment>>.
Such access occurs in the ename:VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_FRAGMENT_SHADER_BIT
or ename:VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_COMPUTE_SHADER_BIT pipeline stages.

items.name: VK_ACCESS_2_DATA_GRAPH_READ_BIT_ARM
items.text:
ename:VK_ACCESS_2_DATA_GRAPH_READ_BIT_ARM specifies read access to
resources in the ename:VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_DATA_GRAPH_BIT_ARM pipeline
stage.

items.name: VK_ACCESS_2_DATA_GRAPH_WRITE_BIT_ARM
items.text:
ename:VK_ACCESS_2_DATA_GRAPH_WRITE_BIT_ARM specifies write access to
resources in the ename:VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_DATA_GRAPH_BIT_ARM pipeline
stage.

items.name: VK_ACCESS_2_SAMPLER_HEAP_READ_BIT_EXT
items.text:
ename:VK_ACCESS_2_SAMPLER_HEAP_READ_BIT_EXT specifies read access to a
sampler heap in any shader pipeline stage.

items.name: VK_ACCESS_2_RESOURCE_HEAP_READ_BIT_EXT
items.text:
ename:VK_ACCESS_2_RESOURCE_HEAP_READ_BIT_EXT specifies read access to a
resource heap in any shader pipeline stage.

pages.name: VkAccessFlagBits2

pages.desc: Access flags for VkAccessFlags3KHR

items.name: VK_ACCESS_3_NONE_KHR
items.text: ename:VK_ACCESS_3_NONE_KHR specifies no additional accesses.

pages.name: VkAccessFlagBits3KHR

pages.desc: Bitmask of VkAccessFlagBits
pages.name: VkAccessFlags

pages.desc: 64-bit mask of access flags
pages.name: VkAccessFlags2

pages.desc: 64-bit mask of access flags
pages.name: VkAccessFlags3KHR

pages.desc: Structure specifying parameters of the acquire

items.name: sType
items.text: pname:sType is a elink:VkStructureType value identifying this structure.

items.name: pNext
items.text:
pname:pNext is `NULL` or a pointer to a structure extending this
structure.

items.name: swapchain
items.text:
pname:swapchain is a non-retired swapchain from which an image is
acquired.

items.name: timeout
items.text:
pname:timeout specifies how long the function waits, in nanoseconds, if
no image is available.

items.name: semaphore
items.text:
pname:semaphore is dlink:VK_NULL_HANDLE or a semaphore that defines a
<<synchronization-semaphores-signaling,semaphore signal operation>>.

items.name: fence
items.text: pname:fence is dlink:VK_NULL_HANDLE or a fence to signal.

items.name: deviceMask
items.text:
pname:deviceMask is a mask of physical devices for which the swapchain
image will be ready to use when the semaphore or fence is signaled.

pages.name: VkAcquireNextImageInfoKHR

pages.desc: Reserved for future use
pages.name: VkAcquireProfilingLockFlagBitsKHR

pages.desc: Reserved for future use
pages.name: VkAcquireProfilingLockFlagsKHR

pages.desc: Structure specifying parameters to acquire the profiling lock

items.name: sType
items.text: pname:sType is a elink:VkStructureType value identifying this structure.

items.name: pNext
items.text:
pname:pNext is `NULL` or a pointer to a structure extending this
structure.

items.name: flags
items.text: pname:flags is reserved for future use.

items.name: timeout
items.text:
pname:timeout indicates how long the function waits, in nanoseconds, if
the profiling lock is not available.

pages.name: VkAcquireProfilingLockInfoKHR

pages.desc: Bitmask specifying address copy parameters

items.name: VK_ADDRESS_COMMAND_PROTECTED_BIT_KHR
items.text:
ename:VK_ADDRESS_COMMAND_PROTECTED_BIT_KHR specifies that an address
range is allocated from protected memory.

items.name: VK_ADDRESS_COMMAND_FULLY_BOUND_BIT_KHR
items.text:
ename:VK_ADDRESS_COMMAND_FULLY_BOUND_BIT_KHR specifies that an address
range will be fully bound to physical memory when accessed.

items.name: VK_ADDRESS_COMMAND_STORAGE_BUFFER_USAGE_BIT_KHR
items.text:
ename:VK_ADDRESS_COMMAND_STORAGE_BUFFER_USAGE_BIT_KHR specifies that all
buffers containing any part of an address range were created with the
ename:VK_BUFFER_USAGE_STORAGE_BUFFER_BIT usage.

items.name: VK_ADDRESS_COMMAND_UNKNOWN_STORAGE_BUFFER_USAGE_BIT_KHR
items.text:
ename:VK_ADDRESS_COMMAND_UNKNOWN_STORAGE_BUFFER_USAGE_BIT_KHR specifies
that whether buffers containing an any part of an address range were
created with ename:VK_BUFFER_USAGE_STORAGE_BUFFER_BIT usage or not is
unknown.

items.name: VK_ADDRESS_COMMAND_TRANSFORM_FEEDBACK_BUFFER_USAGE_BIT_KHR
items.text:
ename:VK_ADDRESS_COMMAND_TRANSFORM_FEEDBACK_BUFFER_USAGE_BIT_KHR
specifies that all buffers containing any part of an address range are
allocated with the
ename:VK_BUFFER_USAGE_TRANSFORM_FEEDBACK_BUFFER_BIT_EXT usage.

items.name: VK_ADDRESS_COMMAND_UNKNOWN_TRANSFORM_FEEDBACK_BUFFER_USAGE_BIT_KHR
items.text:
ename:VK_ADDRESS_COMMAND_UNKNOWN_TRANSFORM_FEEDBACK_BUFFER_USAGE_BIT_KHR
specifies that whether buffers containing an any part of an address
range were created with
ename:VK_BUFFER_USAGE_TRANSFORM_FEEDBACK_BUFFER_BIT_EXT usage or not is
unknown.

pages.name: VkAddressCommandFlagBitsKHR

pages.desc: Bitmask of VkAddressCommandFlagBitsKHR
pages.name: VkAddressCommandFlagsKHR

pages.desc: Bitmask specifying address copy parameters

items.name: VK_ADDRESS_COPY_DEVICE_LOCAL_BIT_KHR
items.text:
ename:VK_ADDRESS_COPY_DEVICE_LOCAL_BIT_KHR specifies that the address
range is expected to be resident in device local memory.
Specifying this value is optional, but may: lead to improved performance
if set accurately.

items.name: VK_ADDRESS_COPY_PROTECTED_BIT_KHR
items.text:
ename:VK_ADDRESS_COPY_PROTECTED_BIT_KHR specifies that the address range
is allocated from protected memory.

items.name: VK_ADDRESS_COPY_SPARSE_BIT_KHR
items.text:
ename:VK_ADDRESS_COPY_SPARSE_BIT_KHR specifies that the address range
may not be fully bound to physical memory when accessed.

pages.name: VkAddressCopyFlagBitsKHR

pages.desc: Bitmask of VkAddressCopyFlagBitsKHR
pages.name: VkAddressCopyFlagsKHR

pages.desc: Structure containing callback function pointers for memory allocation

items.name: pUserData
items.text:
pname:pUserData is NULL or an application-defined user data pointer to
be interpreted by the implementation of the callbacks.
When any of the callbacks in sname:VkAllocationCallbacks are called, the
Vulkan implementation will pass this value as the first parameter to the
callback.
This value can: vary each time an allocator is passed into a command,
even when the same object takes an allocator in multiple commands.

items.name: pfnAllocation
items.text:
pname:pfnAllocation is a tlink:PFN_vkAllocationFunction pointer to an
application-defined memory allocation function.

items.name: pfnReallocation
items.text:
pname:pfnReallocation is a tlink:PFN_vkReallocationFunction pointer to
an application-defined memory reallocation function.

pages.desc: Specify how contents of an attachment are treated at the beginning of the subpass where it is first used

items.name: VK_ATTACHMENT_LOAD_OP_LOAD
items.text:
ename:VK_ATTACHMENT_LOAD_OP_LOAD specifies that the previous contents of
the image within the render area will be preserved as the initial
values.
For attachments with a depth/stencil format, this uses the access type
ename:VK_ACCESS_DEPTH_STENCIL_ATTACHMENT_READ_BIT.
For attachments with a color format, this uses the access type
ename:VK_ACCESS_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_READ_BIT.

items.name: VK_ATTACHMENT_LOAD_OP_CLEAR
items.text:
ename:VK_ATTACHMENT_LOAD_OP_CLEAR specifies that the contents within the
render area will be cleared to a uniform value, which is specified when
a render pass instance is begun.
For attachments with a depth/stencil format, this uses the access type
ename:VK_ACCESS_DEPTH_STENCIL_ATTACHMENT_WRITE_BIT.
For attachments with a color format, this uses the access type
ename:VK_ACCESS_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_WRITE_BIT.

items.name: VK_ATTACHMENT_LOAD_OP_DONT_CARE
items.text:
ename:VK_ATTACHMENT_LOAD_OP_DONT_CARE specifies that the previous
contents within the area need not be preserved; the contents of the
attachment will be undefined: inside the render area.
For attachments with a depth/stencil format, this uses the access type
ename:VK_ACCESS_DEPTH_STENCIL_ATTACHMENT_WRITE_BIT.
For attachments with a color format, this uses the access type
ename:VK_ACCESS_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_WRITE_BIT.

items.name: VK_ATTACHMENT_LOAD_OP_NONE
items.text:
ename:VK_ATTACHMENT_LOAD_OP_NONE specifies that the previous contents of
the image will be undefined: inside the render pass.
No access type is used as the image is not accessed.

items.name: VK_ATTACHMENT_STORE_OP_STORE
items.text:
ename:VK_ATTACHMENT_STORE_OP_STORE specifies the contents generated
during the render pass and within the render area are written to memory.
For attachments with a depth/stencil format, this uses the access type
ename:VK_ACCESS_DEPTH_STENCIL_ATTACHMENT_WRITE_BIT.
For attachments with a color format, this uses the access type
ename:VK_ACCESS_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_WRITE_BIT.

items.name: VK_ATTACHMENT_STORE_OP_DONT_CARE
items.text:
ename:VK_ATTACHMENT_STORE_OP_DONT_CARE specifies the contents within the
render area are not needed after rendering, and may: be discarded; the
contents of the attachment will be undefined: inside the render area.
For attachments with a depth/stencil format, this uses the access type
ename:VK_ACCESS_DEPTH_STENCIL_ATTACHMENT_WRITE_BIT.
For attachments with a color format, this uses the access type
ename:VK_ACCESS_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_WRITE_BIT.

items.name: VK_ATTACHMENT_STORE_OP_NONE
items.text:
ename:VK_ATTACHMENT_STORE_OP_NONE specifies the contents within the
render area are not accessed by the store operation as long as no values
are written to the attachment during the render pass.
If values are written during the render pass, this behaves identically
to ename:VK_ATTACHMENT_STORE_OP_DONT_CARE and with matching access
semantics.

items.name: VK_BUFFER_CREATE_SPARSE_BINDING_BIT
items.text:
ename:VK_BUFFER_CREATE_SPARSE_BINDING_BIT specifies that the buffer will
be backed using sparse memory binding.

items.name: VK_BUFFER_CREATE_SPARSE_RESIDENCY_BIT
items.text:
ename:VK_BUFFER_CREATE_SPARSE_RESIDENCY_BIT specifies that the buffer
can: be partially backed using sparse memory binding.
Buffers created with this flag must: also be created with the
ename:VK_BUFFER_CREATE_SPARSE_BINDING_BIT flag.

items.name: VK_BUFFER_CREATE_SPARSE_ALIASED_BIT
items.text:
ename:VK_BUFFER_CREATE_SPARSE_ALIASED_BIT specifies that the buffer will
be backed using sparse memory binding with memory ranges that might also
simultaneously be backing another buffer (or another portion of the same
buffer).
Buffers created with this flag must: also be created with the
ename:VK_BUFFER_CREATE_SPARSE_BINDING_BIT flag.

items.name: VK_BUFFER_CREATE_PROTECTED_BIT
items.text:
ename:VK_BUFFER_CREATE_PROTECTED_BIT specifies that the buffer is a
protected buffer.

items.name: VK_BUFFER_CREATE_DEVICE_ADDRESS_CAPTURE_REPLAY_BIT
items.text:
ename:VK_BUFFER_CREATE_DEVICE_ADDRESS_CAPTURE_REPLAY_BIT specifies that
the buffer's address can: be saved and reused on a subsequent run (e.g.
for trace capture and replay), see
slink:VkBufferOpaqueCaptureAddressCreateInfo for more detail.

items.name: VK_BUFFER_CREATE_DESCRIPTOR_BUFFER_CAPTURE_REPLAY_BIT_EXT
items.text:
ename:VK_BUFFER_CREATE_DESCRIPTOR_BUFFER_CAPTURE_REPLAY_BIT_EXT
specifies that the buffer can: be used with descriptor buffers when
capturing and replaying (e.g. for trace capture and replay), see
slink:VkOpaqueCaptureDescriptorDataCreateInfoEXT for more detail.

items.name: VK_BUFFER_CREATE_VIDEO_PROFILE_INDEPENDENT_BIT_KHR
items.text:
ename:VK_BUFFER_CREATE_VIDEO_PROFILE_INDEPENDENT_BIT_KHR specifies that
the buffer can: be used in <<video-coding,video coding operations>>
without having to specify at buffer creation time the set of video
profiles the buffer will be used with.

items.name: bufferOffset
items.text:
pname:bufferOffset is the offset in bytes from the start of the buffer
object where the image data is copied from or to.

items.name: bufferRowLength
items.text:
pname:bufferRowLength and pname:bufferImageHeight specify in texels a
subregion of a larger two- or three-dimensional image in buffer memory,
and control the addressing calculations.
If either of these values is zero, that aspect of the buffer memory is
considered to be tightly packed according to the pname:imageExtent.

items.name: imageSubresource
items.text:
pname:imageSubresource is a slink:VkImageSubresourceLayers used to
specify the specific image subresources of the image used for the source
or destination image data.

items.name: imageOffset
items.text:

in texels of the sub-region of the source or destination image data.

items.name: imageExtent
items.text:
pname:imageExtent is the size in texels of the image to copy in
pname:width, pname:height and pname:depth.

items.name: VK_BUFFER_USAGE_TRANSFER_SRC_BIT
items.text:
ename:VK_BUFFER_USAGE_TRANSFER_SRC_BIT specifies that the buffer can: be
used as the source of a _transfer command_ (see the definition of
<<synchronization-pipeline-stages-transfer,
ename:VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TRANSFER_BIT>>).

items.name: VK_BUFFER_USAGE_TRANSFER_DST_BIT
items.text:
ename:VK_BUFFER_USAGE_TRANSFER_DST_BIT specifies that the buffer can: be
used as the destination of a transfer command.

items.name: VK_BUFFER_USAGE_UNIFORM_TEXEL_BUFFER_BIT
items.text:
ename:VK_BUFFER_USAGE_UNIFORM_TEXEL_BUFFER_BIT specifies that the buffer
can: be used to create a sname:VkBufferView suitable for occupying a
sname:VkDescriptorSet slot of type
ename:VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_UNIFORM_TEXEL_BUFFER.

items.name: VK_BUFFER_USAGE_STORAGE_TEXEL_BUFFER_BIT
items.text:
ename:VK_BUFFER_USAGE_STORAGE_TEXEL_BUFFER_BIT specifies that the buffer
can: be used to create a sname:VkBufferView suitable for occupying a
sname:VkDescriptorSet slot of type
ename:VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_STORAGE_TEXEL_BUFFER.

items.name: VK_BUFFER_USAGE_UNIFORM_BUFFER_BIT
items.text:
ename:VK_BUFFER_USAGE_UNIFORM_BUFFER_BIT specifies that the buffer can:
be used in a sname:VkDescriptorBufferInfo suitable for occupying a
sname:VkDescriptorSet slot either of type
ename:VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_UNIFORM_BUFFER or
ename:VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_UNIFORM_BUFFER_DYNAMIC.

items.name: VK_BUFFER_USAGE_STORAGE_BUFFER_BIT
items.text:
ename:VK_BUFFER_USAGE_STORAGE_BUFFER_BIT specifies that the buffer can:
be used in a sname:VkDescriptorBufferInfo suitable for occupying a
sname:VkDescriptorSet slot either of type
ename:VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_STORAGE_BUFFER or
ename:VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_STORAGE_BUFFER_DYNAMIC.

items.name: VK_BUFFER_USAGE_INDEX_BUFFER_BIT
items.text:
ename:VK_BUFFER_USAGE_INDEX_BUFFER_BIT specifies that the buffer is
suitable for passing as the pname:buffer parameter to
flink:vkCmdBindIndexBuffer2 and
flink:vkCmdBindIndexBuffer.

items.name: VK_BUFFER_USAGE_VERTEX_BUFFER_BIT
items.text:
ename:VK_BUFFER_USAGE_VERTEX_BUFFER_BIT specifies that the buffer is
suitable for passing as an element of the pname:pBuffers array to
flink:vkCmdBindVertexBuffers.

items.name: VK_BUFFER_USAGE_INDIRECT_BUFFER_BIT
items.text:
ename:VK_BUFFER_USAGE_INDIRECT_BUFFER_BIT specifies that the buffer is
suitable for passing as the pname:buffer parameter to
flink:vkCmdDrawIndirect, flink:vkCmdDrawIndexedIndirect,
flink:vkCmdDrawMeshTasksIndirectNV,
flink:vkCmdDrawMeshTasksIndirectCountNV,
fname:vkCmdDrawMeshTasksIndirectEXT,
fname:vkCmdDrawMeshTasksIndirectCountEXT,
flink:vkCmdDrawClusterIndirectHUAWEI,
or flink:vkCmdDispatchIndirect.
It is also suitable for passing as the pname:buffer member of
sname:VkIndirectCommandsStreamNV, or pname:sequencesCountBuffer or
pname:sequencesIndexBuffer or pname:preprocessedBuffer member of
sname:VkGeneratedCommandsInfoNV.
It is also suitable for passing as the underlying buffer of either the
pname:preprocessAddress or pname:sequenceCountAddress members of
sname:VkGeneratedCommandsInfoEXT.

items.name: VK_BUFFER_USAGE_CONDITIONAL_RENDERING_BIT_EXT
items.text:
ename:VK_BUFFER_USAGE_CONDITIONAL_RENDERING_BIT_EXT specifies that the
buffer is suitable for passing as the pname:buffer parameter to
flink:vkCmdBeginConditionalRenderingEXT.

items.name: VK_BUFFER_USAGE_TRANSFORM_FEEDBACK_BUFFER_BIT_EXT
items.text:
ename:VK_BUFFER_USAGE_TRANSFORM_FEEDBACK_BUFFER_BIT_EXT specifies that
the buffer is suitable for using for binding as a transform feedback
buffer with
flink:vkCmdBindTransformFeedbackBuffers2EXT or
flink:vkCmdBindTransformFeedbackBuffersEXT.

items.name: VK_BUFFER_USAGE_TRANSFORM_FEEDBACK_COUNTER_BUFFER_BIT_EXT
items.text:
ename:VK_BUFFER_USAGE_TRANSFORM_FEEDBACK_COUNTER_BUFFER_BIT_EXT
specifies that the buffer is suitable for using as a counter buffer with
flink:vkCmdBeginTransformFeedback2EXT,
flink:vkCmdEndTransformFeedback2EXT,
flink:vkCmdBeginTransformFeedbackEXT, and
flink:vkCmdEndTransformFeedbackEXT.

items.name: VK_BUFFER_USAGE_SAMPLER_DESCRIPTOR_BUFFER_BIT_EXT
items.text:
ename:VK_BUFFER_USAGE_SAMPLER_DESCRIPTOR_BUFFER_BIT_EXT specifies that
the buffer is suitable to contain sampler and combined image sampler
descriptors when bound as a descriptor buffer.
Buffers containing combined image sampler descriptors must: also specify
ename:VK_BUFFER_USAGE_RESOURCE_DESCRIPTOR_BUFFER_BIT_EXT.

items.name: VK_BUFFER_USAGE_RESOURCE_DESCRIPTOR_BUFFER_BIT_EXT
items.text:
ename:VK_BUFFER_USAGE_RESOURCE_DESCRIPTOR_BUFFER_BIT_EXT specifies that
the buffer is suitable to contain resource descriptors when bound as a
descriptor buffer.

items.name: VK_BUFFER_USAGE_PUSH_DESCRIPTORS_DESCRIPTOR_BUFFER_BIT_EXT
items.text:
ename:VK_BUFFER_USAGE_PUSH_DESCRIPTORS_DESCRIPTOR_BUFFER_BIT_EXT
specifies that the buffer, when bound, can: be used by the
implementation to support push descriptors when using descriptor
buffers.

items.name: VK_BUFFER_USAGE_MICROMAP_BUILD_INPUT_READ_ONLY_BIT_EXT
items.text:
ename:VK_BUFFER_USAGE_MICROMAP_BUILD_INPUT_READ_ONLY_BIT_EXT specifies
that when building a slink:VkMicromapEXT, the buffer can: be used as a
<<micromap-building,read-only micromap build input>>, which includes the
pname:data and pname:triangleArray parameters

items.name: VK_BUFFER_USAGE_MICROMAP_STORAGE_BIT_EXT
items.text:
ename:VK_BUFFER_USAGE_MICROMAP_STORAGE_BIT_EXT specifies that the buffer
can: be used to <<resources-micromaps,create slink:VkMicromapEXT
objects>>.

items.name: VK_BUFFER_USAGE_TILE_MEMORY_BIT_QCOM
items.text:
ename:VK_BUFFER_USAGE_TILE_MEMORY_BIT_QCOM specifies that the buffer
can: be bound to sname:VkDeviceMemory allocated from a
slink:VkMemoryHeap with the ename:VK_MEMORY_HEAP_TILE_MEMORY_BIT_QCOM
property.

items.name: VK_BUFFER_USAGE_RAY_TRACING_BIT_NV
items.text:
ename:VK_BUFFER_USAGE_RAY_TRACING_BIT_NV specifies that the buffer is
suitable for use in flink:vkCmdTraceRaysNV.

items.name: VK_BUFFER_USAGE_SHADER_BINDING_TABLE_BIT_KHR
items.text:
ename:VK_BUFFER_USAGE_SHADER_BINDING_TABLE_BIT_KHR specifies that the
buffer is suitable for use as a <<shader-binding-table,Shader Binding

items.name: VK_BUFFER_USAGE_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_BUILD_INPUT_READ_ONLY_BIT_KHR
items.text:
ename:VK_BUFFER_USAGE_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_BUILD_INPUT_READ_ONLY_BIT_KHR
specifies that the buffer is suitable for use as a read-only input to an
<<acceleration-structure-building,acceleration structure build>>.

items.name: VK_BUFFER_USAGE_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_STORAGE_BIT_KHR
items.text:
ename:VK_BUFFER_USAGE_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_STORAGE_BIT_KHR specifies
that the buffer is suitable for storage space for a
slink:VkAccelerationStructureKHR.

items.name: VK_BUFFER_USAGE_SHADER_DEVICE_ADDRESS_BIT
items.text:
ename:VK_BUFFER_USAGE_SHADER_DEVICE_ADDRESS_BIT specifies that the
buffer can: be used to retrieve a buffer device address via
flink:vkGetBufferDeviceAddress and use that address to access the
buffer's memory from a shader.

items.name: VK_BUFFER_USAGE_VIDEO_DECODE_SRC_BIT_KHR
items.text:
ename:VK_BUFFER_USAGE_VIDEO_DECODE_SRC_BIT_KHR specifies that the buffer
can: be used as the source video bitstream buffer in a
<<video-decode-operations, video decode operation>>.

items.name: VK_BUFFER_USAGE_VIDEO_DECODE_DST_BIT_KHR
items.text:

use.

items.name: VK_BUFFER_USAGE_VIDEO_ENCODE_DST_BIT_KHR
items.text:

items.name: VK_BUFFER_USAGE_VIDEO_ENCODE_SRC_BIT_KHR

flink:vkCmdDrawIndirect, flink:vkCmdDrawIndexedIndirect,
flink:vkCmdDrawMeshTasksIndirectNV,
flink:vkCmdDrawMeshTasksIndirectCountNV,
fname:vkCmdDrawMeshTasksIndirectEXT,
fname:vkCmdDrawMeshTasksIndirectCountEXT,
flink:vkCmdDrawClusterIndirectHUAWEI,
or flink:vkCmdDispatchIndirect.
It is also suitable for passing as the pname:buffer member of
sname:VkIndirectCommandsStreamNV, or pname:sequencesCountBuffer or
pname:sequencesIndexBuffer or pname:preprocessedBuffer member of
sname:VkGeneratedCommandsInfoNV.
It is also suitable for passing as the underlying buffer of either the
pname:preprocessAddress or pname:sequenceCountAddress members of
sname:VkGeneratedCommandsInfoEXT.

items.name: VK_BUFFER_USAGE_2_CONDITIONAL_RENDERING_BIT_EXT
items.text:
ename:VK_BUFFER_USAGE_2_CONDITIONAL_RENDERING_BIT_EXT specifies that the
buffer is suitable for passing as the pname:buffer parameter to
flink:vkCmdBeginConditionalRenderingEXT.

items.name: VK_BUFFER_USAGE_2_TRANSFORM_FEEDBACK_BUFFER_BIT_EXT
items.text:
ename:VK_BUFFER_USAGE_2_TRANSFORM_FEEDBACK_BUFFER_BIT_EXT specifies that
the buffer is suitable for using for binding as a transform feedback
buffer with
flink:vkCmdBindTransformFeedbackBuffers2EXT or
flink:vkCmdBindTransformFeedbackBuffersEXT.

items.name: VK_BUFFER_USAGE_2_TRANSFORM_FEEDBACK_COUNTER_BUFFER_BIT_EXT
items.text:
ename:VK_BUFFER_USAGE_2_TRANSFORM_FEEDBACK_COUNTER_BUFFER_BIT_EXT
specifies that the buffer is suitable for using as a counter buffer with
flink:vkCmdBeginTransformFeedback2EXT,
flink:vkCmdEndTransformFeedback2EXT,
flink:vkCmdBeginTransformFeedbackEXT, and
flink:vkCmdEndTransformFeedbackEXT.

items.name: VK_BUFFER_USAGE_2_SAMPLER_DESCRIPTOR_BUFFER_BIT_EXT
items.text:
ename:VK_BUFFER_USAGE_2_SAMPLER_DESCRIPTOR_BUFFER_BIT_EXT specifies that
the buffer is suitable to contain sampler and combined image sampler
descriptors when bound as a descriptor buffer.
Buffers containing combined image sampler descriptors must: also specify
ename:VK_BUFFER_USAGE_2_RESOURCE_DESCRIPTOR_BUFFER_BIT_EXT.

items.name: VK_BUFFER_USAGE_2_RESOURCE_DESCRIPTOR_BUFFER_BIT_EXT
items.text:
ename:VK_BUFFER_USAGE_2_RESOURCE_DESCRIPTOR_BUFFER_BIT_EXT specifies
that the buffer is suitable to contain resource descriptors when bound
as a descriptor buffer.

items.name: VK_BUFFER_USAGE_2_PUSH_DESCRIPTORS_DESCRIPTOR_BUFFER_BIT_EXT
items.text:
ename:VK_BUFFER_USAGE_2_PUSH_DESCRIPTORS_DESCRIPTOR_BUFFER_BIT_EXT
specifies that the buffer, when bound, can: be used by the
implementation to support push descriptors when using descriptor
buffers.

items.name: VK_BUFFER_USAGE_2_TILE_MEMORY_BIT_QCOM
items.text:
ename:VK_BUFFER_USAGE_2_TILE_MEMORY_BIT_QCOM specifies that the buffer
can: be bound to sname:VkDeviceMemory allocated from a
slink:VkMemoryHeap with the ename:VK_MEMORY_HEAP_TILE_MEMORY_BIT_QCOM
property.

items.name: VK_BUFFER_USAGE_2_RAY_TRACING_BIT_NV
items.text:
ename:VK_BUFFER_USAGE_2_RAY_TRACING_BIT_NV specifies that the buffer is
suitable for use in flink:vkCmdTraceRaysNV.

items.name: VK_BUFFER_USAGE_2_SHADER_BINDING_TABLE_BIT_KHR
items.text:
ename:VK_BUFFER_USAGE_2_SHADER_BINDING_TABLE_BIT_KHR specifies that the
buffer is suitable for use as a <<shader-binding-table,Shader Binding
Table>>.

items.name: VK_BUFFER_USAGE_2_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_BUILD_INPUT_READ_ONLY_BIT_KHR
items.text:
ename:VK_BUFFER_USAGE_2_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_BUILD_INPUT_READ_ONLY_BIT_KHR
specifies that the buffer is suitable for use as a read-only input to an
<<acceleration-structure-building,acceleration structure build>>.

items.name: VK_BUFFER_USAGE_2_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_STORAGE_BIT_KHR
items.text:
ename:VK_BUFFER_USAGE_2_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_STORAGE_BIT_KHR specifies
that the buffer is suitable for storage space for a
slink:VkAccelerationStructureKHR.

items.name: VK_BUFFER_USAGE_2_SHADER_DEVICE_ADDRESS_BIT
items.text:
ename:VK_BUFFER_USAGE_2_SHADER_DEVICE_ADDRESS_BIT specifies that the
buffer can: be used to retrieve a buffer device address via
flink:vkGetBufferDeviceAddress and use that address to access the
buffer's memory from a shader.

items.name: VK_BUFFER_USAGE_2_VIDEO_DECODE_SRC_BIT_KHR
items.text:
ename:VK_BUFFER_USAGE_2_VIDEO_DECODE_SRC_BIT_KHR specifies that the
buffer can: be used as the source video bitstream buffer in a
<<video-decode-operations, video decode operation>>.

items.text:
ename:VK_BUFFER_USAGE_2_VIDEO_DECODE_DST_BIT_KHR is reserved for future
use.

items.name: VK_BUFFER_USAGE_2_VIDEO_ENCODE_DST_BIT_KHR
items.text:
ename:VK_BUFFER_USAGE_2_VIDEO_ENCODE_DST_BIT_KHR specifies that the
buffer can: be used as the destination video bitstream buffer in a
<<video-encode-operations, video encode operation>>.

items.name: VK_BUFFER_USAGE_2_VIDEO_ENCODE_SRC_BIT_KHR
items.text:
ename:VK_BUFFER_USAGE_2_VIDEO_ENCODE_SRC_BIT_KHR is reserved for future
use.

items.name: VK_BUFFER_USAGE_2_EXECUTION_GRAPH_SCRATCH_BIT_AMDX

ename:VK_BUFFER_USAGE_2_EXECUTION_GRAPH_SCRATCH_BIT_AMDX specifies that
the buffer can: be used for as scratch memory for
<<executiongraphs,execution graph dispatch>>.

items.name: VK_BUFFER_USAGE_2_PREPROCESS_BUFFER_BIT_EXT
items.text:
ename:VK_BUFFER_USAGE_2_PREPROCESS_BUFFER_BIT_EXT specifies that the
buffer can: be used as a preprocess buffer for
<<device-generated-commands,Device-Generated Commands>>.

items.name: VK_BUFFER_USAGE_2_MICROMAP_BUILD_INPUT_READ_ONLY_BIT_EXT
items.text:
ename:VK_BUFFER_USAGE_2_MICROMAP_BUILD_INPUT_READ_ONLY_BIT_EXT specifies
that the buffer can: be used as a <<micromap-building,read-only
slink:VkMicromapEXT build input>>, which includes the pname:data and
pname:triangleArray parameters

items.name: VK_BUFFER_USAGE_2_MICROMAP_STORAGE_BIT_EXT
items.text:
ename:VK_BUFFER_USAGE_2_MICROMAP_STORAGE_BIT_EXT specifies that the
buffer can: be used to <<resources-micromaps,create slink:VkMicromapEXT
objects>>.

items.name: VK_BUFFER_USAGE_2_COMPRESSED_DATA_DGF1_BIT_AMDX
items.text:
ename:VK_BUFFER_USAGE_2_COMPRESSED_DATA_DGF1_BIT_AMDX specifies that the
buffer is suitable as storage space for <<dense-geometry-format,Dense
Geometry Format>> data.

items.name: VK_BUFFER_USAGE_2_DATA_GRAPH_FOREIGN_DESCRIPTOR_BIT_ARM
items.text:
ename:VK_BUFFER_USAGE_2_DATA_GRAPH_FOREIGN_DESCRIPTOR_BIT_ARM specifies
that the buffer is suitable to contain resource descriptors when bound
as a descriptor buffer in command buffers allocated from a command pool
that can: target foreign <<graphs-processing-engines,data graph
processing engines>>.

items.name: VK_BUFFER_USAGE_2_MEMORY_DECOMPRESSION_BIT_EXT
items.text:
ename:VK_BUFFER_USAGE_2_MEMORY_DECOMPRESSION_BIT_EXT specifies that the
buffer can: be used as a destination buffer in <<memory-decompression,
memory decompression>>.

items.name: VK_BUFFER_USAGE_2_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_BIT_EXT
items.text:
ename:VK_BUFFER_USAGE_2_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_BIT_EXT specifies that the
buffer can: be used as a <<descriptorheaps,descriptor heap>>.

elements in the buffer.

items.text:
pname:offset is an offset in bytes from the base address of the buffer.
Accesses to the buffer view from shaders use addressing that is relative
to this starting offset.

items.text:
pname:range is a size in bytes of the buffer view.
If pname:range is equal to ename:VK_WHOLE_SIZE, the range from
pname:offset to the end of the buffer is used.
If ename:VK_WHOLE_SIZE is used and the remaining size of the buffer is
not a multiple of the <<texel-block-size, texel block size>> of
pname:format, the nearest smaller multiple is used.

items.name: VK_BUILD_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_ALLOW_UPDATE_BIT_KHR
items.text:
ename:VK_BUILD_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_ALLOW_UPDATE_BIT_KHR specifies
that the specified acceleration structure can: be updated with
a pname:mode of ename:VK_BUILD_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_MODE_UPDATE_KHR in
slink:VkAccelerationStructureBuildGeometryInfoKHR
or
an pname:update of ename:VK_TRUE in
flink:vkCmdBuildAccelerationStructureNV
.
For sphere and LSS primitives, only positions and radii may be updated,
the provided index buffers and flags must: remain unchanged from the
initial build.

items.name: VK_BUILD_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_ALLOW_COMPACTION_BIT_KHR
items.text:
ename:VK_BUILD_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_ALLOW_COMPACTION_BIT_KHR specifies
that the specified acceleration structure can: act as the source for a
copy acceleration structure command with pname:mode of
ename:VK_COPY_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_MODE_COMPACT_KHR to produce a
compacted acceleration structure.

items.name: VK_BUILD_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_PREFER_FAST_TRACE_BIT_KHR
items.text:
ename:VK_BUILD_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_PREFER_FAST_TRACE_BIT_KHR
specifies that the given acceleration structure build should: prioritize
trace performance over build time.

items.name: VK_BUILD_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_PREFER_FAST_BUILD_BIT_KHR
items.text:
ename:VK_BUILD_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_PREFER_FAST_BUILD_BIT_KHR
specifies that the given acceleration structure build should: prioritize
build time over trace performance.

items.name: VK_BUILD_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_LOW_MEMORY_BIT_KHR
items.text:
ename:VK_BUILD_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_LOW_MEMORY_BIT_KHR specifies that
this acceleration structure should: minimize the size of the scratch
memory and the final result acceleration structure, potentially at the
expense of build time or trace performance.

items.name: VK_BUILD_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_ALLOW_OPACITY_MICROMAP_UPDATE_BIT_KHR
items.text:
ename:VK_BUILD_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_ALLOW_OPACITY_MICROMAP_UPDATE_BIT_KHR
specifies that the opacity micromaps associated with the specified
acceleration structure may: change with an acceleration structure
update.

items.name: VK_BUILD_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_ALLOW_OPACITY_MICROMAP_DATA_UPDATE_BIT_EXT
items.text:
ename:VK_BUILD_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_ALLOW_OPACITY_MICROMAP_DATA_UPDATE_BIT_EXT
specifies that the data of the opacity micromaps associated with the
specified acceleration structure may: change with an acceleration
structure update.

items.name: VK_BUILD_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_ALLOW_DISABLE_OPACITY_MICROMAPS_BIT_KHR
items.text:
ename:VK_BUILD_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_ALLOW_DISABLE_OPACITY_MICROMAPS_BIT_KHR
specifies that the specified acceleration structure may: be referenced
in an instance with
ename:VK_GEOMETRY_INSTANCE_DISABLE_OPACITY_MICROMAPS_BIT_KHR set.

items.name: VK_BUILD_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_ALLOW_CLUSTER_OPACITY_MICROMAPS_BIT_NV
items.text:
ename:VK_BUILD_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_ALLOW_CLUSTER_OPACITY_MICROMAPS_BIT_NV
specifies that opacity micromaps may: be associated with the given
cluster acceleration structure.

items.name: VK_BUILD_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_ALLOW_DATA_ACCESS_BIT_KHR
items.text:
ename:VK_BUILD_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_ALLOW_DATA_ACCESS_BIT_KHR
specifies that the specified acceleration structure can: be used when
fetching the
vertex and radius positions of a hit LSS or sphere primitive, or
vertex positions of a hit triangle.

items.name: VK_BUILD_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_MICROMAP_LOSSY_BIT_KHR
items.text:
ename:VK_BUILD_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_MICROMAP_LOSSY_BIT_KHR specifies
that micromaps can: be compressed with a lossy encoding as described in
<<ray-opacity-micromap, Ray Opacity Micromap>>, which may: support
additional subdivision levels.

items.name: VK_BUILD_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_ALLOW_DISPLACEMENT_MICROMAP_UPDATE_BIT_NV
items.text:
ename:VK_BUILD_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_ALLOW_DISPLACEMENT_MICROMAP_UPDATE_BIT_NV
specifies that the displacement micromaps associated with the specified
acceleration structure may: change with an acceleration structure
update.

items.name: aspectMask
items.text:
pname:aspectMask is a mask selecting the color, depth and/or stencil
aspects of the attachment to be cleared.

items.name: colorAttachment
items.text:
pname:colorAttachment is only meaningful if
ename:VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT is set in pname:aspectMask, in which
case it is an index into the bound color attachments.

items.name: clearValue
items.text:
pname:clearValue is the color or depth/stencil value to clear the
attachment to, as described in <<clears-values,Clear Values>> below.

pages.name: VkClearAttachment

pages.desc: Structure specifying a clear color value

items.name: float32
items.text:
pname:float32 are the color clear values when the format of the image or
attachment is one of the <<formats-numericformat, numeric formats>> with
a numeric type that is floating-point.
Floating-point values are automatically converted to the format of the
image, with the clear value being treated as linear if the image is
sRGB.

items.name: int32
items.text:
pname:int32 are the color clear values when the format of the image or
attachment has a numeric type that is signed integer (etext:SINT).
Signed integer values are converted to the format of the image by
casting to the smaller type (with negative 32-bit values mapping to
negative values in the smaller type).
If the integer clear value is not representable in the target type (e.g.
would overflow in conversion to that type), the clear value is
undefined:.

items.name: uint32
items.text:
pname:uint32 are the color clear values when the format of the image or
attachment has a numeric type that is unsigned integer (etext:UINT).
Unsigned integer values are converted to the format of the image by
casting to the integer type with fewer bits.

pages.name: VkClearColorValue

items.name: depth
items.text:
pname:depth is the clear value for the depth aspect of the depth/stencil
attachment.
It is a floating-point value which is automatically converted to the
attachment's format.

items.name: stencil
items.text:
pname:stencil is the clear value for the stencil aspect of the
depth/stencil attachment.
It is a 32-bit integer value which is converted to the attachment's
format by taking the appropriate number of LSBs.

pages.name: VkClusterAccelerationStructureAddressResolutionFlagsNV

pages.desc: Parameters describing build operation for a bottom level cluster acceleration structure

items.name: clusterReferencesCount
items.text:
pname:clusterReferencesCount is the number of clusters this bottom level
acceleration structure will be built from.

items.name: clusterReferencesStride
items.text: pname:clusterReferencesStride is the stride in pname:clusterReferences.

items.name: clusterReferences
items.text:
pname:clusterReferences is the device memory containing the address of
the clusters.

pages.name: VkClusterAccelerationStructureBuildClustersBottomLevelInfoNV

pages.desc: Parameters describing build operation for a cluster acceleration structure

items.name: clusterID
items.text: pname:clusterID is a user specified identifier assigned to this cluster.

items.name: clusterFlags
items.text:
pname:clusterFlags is a bitmask of
elink:VkClusterAccelerationStructureClusterFlagBitsNV values describing
flags how the cluster should be built.

items.name: triangleCount
items.text: pname:triangleCount is the number of triangles in this cluster.

items.name: vertexCount
items.text: pname:vertexCount is the number of unique vertices in this cluster.

items.name: positionTruncateBitCount
items.text:
pname:positionTruncateBitCount is the number of bits starting at the
lowest bit (i.e. the LSBs of the mantissa), of each vertex position that
will be truncated to zero to improve floating-point compression.

items.name: indexType
items.text:
pname:indexType is a single
elink:VkClusterAccelerationStructureIndexFormatFlagBitsNV value
specifying the index type in pname:indexBuffer.

items.name: opacityMicromapIndexType
items.text:
pname:opacityMicromapIndexType is a single
elink:VkClusterAccelerationStructureIndexFormatFlagBitsNV value
specifying the index type in pname:opacityMicromapIndexBuffer.

items.name: baseGeometryIndexAndGeometryFlags
items.text:
pname:baseGeometryIndexAndGeometryFlags is a
slink:VkClusterAccelerationStructureGeometryIndexAndGeometryFlagsNV
value specifying the base geometry index and flags for all triangles in
the cluster.

items.name: indexBufferStride
items.text:
pname:indexBufferStride is the stride in bytes in pname:indexBuffer with
`0` meaning the values are tightly-packed.

items.name: vertexBufferStride
items.text:
pname:vertexBufferStride is the stride in bytes in pname:vertexBuffer
with `0` meaning the values are tightly-packed.

items.name: geometryIndexAndFlagsBufferStride
items.text:
pname:geometryIndexAndFlagsBufferStride is the stride in bytes in
pname:geometryIndexAndFlagsBuffer with `0` meaning the values are
tightly-packed.

items.name: opacityMicromapIndexBufferStride
items.text:
pname:opacityMicromapIndexBufferStride is the stride in bytes in
pname:opacityMicromapIndexBuffer with `0` meaning the values are
tightly-packed.

items.name: indexBuffer
items.text:
pname:indexBuffer is a device address containing the indices of the
vertices in the cluster and are of type pname:indexType.

items.name: vertexBuffer
items.text:
pname:vertexBuffer is a device address containing the vertex data of the
triangles in the cluster with format specified in
slink:VkClusterAccelerationStructureTriangleClusterInputNV::pname:vertexFormat.

items.name: geometryIndexAndFlagsBuffer
items.text:
pname:geometryIndexAndFlagsBuffer is
either `0` or an address containing strided
slink:VkClusterAccelerationStructureGeometryIndexAndGeometryFlagsNV
values specifying the geometry index and flag for every triangle in the
cluster.

items.name: opacityMicromapArray
items.text:
pname:opacityMicromapArray is either `0` or specifies the address of a
valid opacity micromap array to reference from the cluster acceleration
structure.
If it is `0`, then opacity micromaps will be disabled for this cluster
acceleration structure.

items.name: opacityMicromapIndexBuffer
items.text:
pname:opacityMicromapIndexBuffer is either `0` or specifies the address
of a strided array with size equal to the number of triangles or indices
into the opacity micromap array.
If pname:opacityMicromapIndexBuffer is `0` then the index used is the
index of the triangle in the geometry.

items.name: triangleCount
items.text:
pname:triangleCount, pname:vertexCount, pname:positionTruncateBitCount,
pname:indexType and pname:opacityMicromapIndexType occupy the same
memory as if a single code:uint32_t was specified in their place
** pname:triangleCount occupies the 9 least significant bits of that
memory
** pname:vertexCount occupies the next 9 least significant bits of that
memory
** pname:positionTruncateBitCount occupies the next 6 least significant
bits of that memory
** pname:indexType occupies the next 4 least significant bits of that
memory
** pname:opacityMicromapIndexType occupies the 4 most significant bits of
that memory

items.text:
pname:baseGeometryIndexAndGeometryFlags is a

items.name: indexBufferStride
items.text: pname:indexBufferStride is the stride in bytes in pname:indexBuffer.

items.text: pname:vertexBufferStride is the stride in bytes in pname:vertexBuffer.

items.name: geometryIndexAndFlagsBufferStride
items.text:
pname:geometryIndexAndFlagsBufferStride is the stride in bytes in

items.name: opacityMicromapIndexBufferStride

pname:opacityMicromapIndexBufferStride is the stride in bytes in

items.name: indexBuffer
items.text:
pname:indexBuffer contains the indices of vertices in the cluster and is
of type pname:indexType.

items.name: vertexBuffer
items.text:
pname:vertexBuffer is either `0` or specifies the vertex data of the
triangles in the cluster template with format specified in

items.name: geometryIndexAndFlagsBuffer

pname:geometryIndexAndFlagsBuffer is either `0` or an address containing
strided
slink:VkClusterAccelerationStructureGeometryIndexAndGeometryFlagsNV
values specifying the geometry index and flag for every triangle in the

items.name: opacityMicromapArray

pname:opacityMicromapArray is either `0` or specifies the address of a
valid opacity micromap array to reference from the cluster acceleration
structure.
If it is `0`, then opacity micromaps will be disabled for this cluster
acceleration structure.

items.name: opacityMicromapIndexBuffer
items.text:
pname:opacityMicromapIndexBuffer is either `0` or specifies the address
of a strided array with size equal to the number of triangles or indices
into the opacity micromap array.
If pname:opacityMicromapIndexBuffer is `0` then the index used is the
index of the triangle in the geometry.

items.name: instantiationBoundingBoxLimit

pname:instantiationBoundingBoxLimit is either `0` or specifies the
address of a bounding box within which all instantiated clusters must:

The bounding box is specified by six 32-bit floating-point values in the
order MinX, MinY, MinZ, MaxX, MaxY, MaxZ.

memory as if a single code:uint32_t was specified in their place
** pname:triangleCount occupies the 9 least significant bits of that
memory
** pname:vertexCount occupies the next 9 least significant bits of that
memory
** pname:positionTruncateBitCount occupies the next 6 least significant
bits of that memory
** pname:indexType occupies the next 4 least significant bits of that
memory

items.name: VK_CLUSTER_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_CLUSTER_ALLOW_DISABLE_OPACITY_MICROMAPS_NV

pages.desc: Parameters describing bottom level acceleration structure

items.name: sType
items.text: pname:sType is a elink:VkStructureType value identifying this structure.

items.name: pNext
items.text:
pname:pNext is `NULL` or a pointer to a structure extending this
structure.

items.name: maxTotalClusterCount
items.text:
pname:maxTotalClusterCount is the total number of clusters acceleration
structures that will be built or moved across all input arguments.

items.name: maxClusterCountPerAccelerationStructure
items.text:
pname:maxClusterCountPerAccelerationStructure is the maximum number of
clusters acceleration structures that will be built or moved per input
argument.

pages.name: VkClusterAccelerationStructureClustersBottomLevelInputNV

pages.desc: Structure describing parameters for building for moving an acceleration structure

items.name: sType
items.text: pname:sType is a elink:VkStructureType value identifying this structure.

items.name: pNext
items.text:
pname:pNext is `NULL` or a pointer to a structure extending this
structure.

items.name: input
items.text:
pname:input is slink:VkClusterAccelerationStructureInputInfoNV structure
describing the build or move parameters for the cluster acceleration
structure.

items.name: dstImplicitData
items.text:
pname:dstImplicitData is the device address for memory where the
implicit build of cluster acceleration structure will be saved.
If slink:VkClusterAccelerationStructureInputInfoNV::pname:opMode is
ename:VK_CLUSTER_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_OP_MODE_EXPLICIT_DESTINATIONS_NV
or ename:VK_CLUSTER_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_OP_MODE_COMPUTE_SIZES_NV,
this value is ignored.

items.name: scratchData
items.text:
pname:scratchData is the device address of scratch memory that will be
used during cluster acceleration structure move or build.

items.name: dstAddressesArray
items.text:
pname:dstAddressesArray is a slink:VkStridedDeviceAddressRegionKHR that
specifies addresses and stride for moved or built cluster acceleration
structures, depending on the value of
slink:VkClusterAccelerationStructureInputInfoNV::pname:opMode.
If slink:VkClusterAccelerationStructureInputInfoNV::pname:opMode is
ename:VK_CLUSTER_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_OP_MODE_IMPLICIT_DESTINATIONS_NV
and slink:VkStridedDeviceAddressRegionKHR::pname:deviceAddress is not
`0`, then the implementation writes the cluster addresses to the
specified region.
If slink:VkClusterAccelerationStructureInputInfoNV::pname:opMode is
ename:VK_CLUSTER_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_OP_MODE_EXPLICIT_DESTINATIONS_NV,
the implementation reads the cluster addresses from the specified
region.
If slink:VkClusterAccelerationStructureInputInfoNV::pname:opMode is
ename:VK_CLUSTER_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_OP_MODE_COMPUTE_SIZES_NV, this
member is ignored.

items.name: dstSizesArray
items.text:
pname:dstSizesArray is a slink:VkStridedDeviceAddressRegionKHR
containing sizes of moved or built cluster acceleration structures.
If slink:VkClusterAccelerationStructureInputInfoNV::pname:opMode is
ename:VK_CLUSTER_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_OP_MODE_IMPLICIT_DESTINATIONS_NV
or ename:VK_CLUSTER_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_OP_MODE_COMPUTE_SIZES_NV,
then the sizes are saved.
If slink:VkClusterAccelerationStructureInputInfoNV::pname:opMode is
ename:VK_CLUSTER_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_OP_MODE_EXPLICIT_DESTINATIONS_NV,
then the sizes are read from.

items.name: srcInfosArray
items.text:
pname:srcInfosArray is a slink:VkStridedDeviceAddressRegionKHR where
input data for the build or move operation is read from.
If the stride is `0`, the structures are assumed to be packed tightly.
Its format is dependent on
slink:VkClusterAccelerationStructureInputInfoNV::pname:opType as per the
table below.

items.name: srcInfosCount
items.text:
pname:srcInfosCount is the device address of memory containing the count
of number of build or move operations to perform.
The actual value is the minimum of this value and the value specified in
pname:input.maxAccelerationStructureCount.
If this value is `0`, the count is determined by
pname:input.maxAccelerationStructureCount alone.

items.name: addressResolutionFlags
items.text:
pname:addressResolutionFlags is a bitmask of
elink:VkClusterAccelerationStructureAddressResolutionFlagBitsNV values
specifying how an implementation will interpret the device addresses in
this structure.

pages.name: VkClusterAccelerationStructureCommandsInfoNV

pages.desc: Bitmask specifying geometry flags for cluster acceleration structure

items.name: VK_CLUSTER_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_GEOMETRY_CULL_DISABLE_BIT_NV
items.text:
ename:VK_CLUSTER_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_GEOMETRY_CULL_DISABLE_BIT_NV
disables face culling for this geometry.

items.name: VK_CLUSTER_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_GEOMETRY_NO_DUPLICATE_ANYHIT_INVOCATION_BIT_NV
items.text:
ename:VK_CLUSTER_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_GEOMETRY_NO_DUPLICATE_ANYHIT_INVOCATION_BIT_NV
specifies that the implementation must: only call the any-hit shader a
single time for each primitive in this geometry.
If this bit is absent an implementation may: invoke the any-hit shader
more than once for this geometry.

items.name: VK_CLUSTER_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_GEOMETRY_OPAQUE_BIT_NV
items.text:
ename:VK_CLUSTER_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_GEOMETRY_OPAQUE_BIT_NV specifies
that this geometry does not invoke the any-hit shaders even if present
in a hit group.

the cluster acceleration structure.

pname:geometryFlags is a bitmask of
elink:VkClusterAccelerationStructureGeometryFlagBitsNV values describing
geometry flags for the cluster acceleration structure.

memory as if a single code:uint32_t was specified in their place
** pname:geometryIndex occupies the 24 least significant bits of that
memory
** pname:geometryFlags occupies the 3 most significant bits of that memory

template acceleration structure whose index data is being fetched.

structure.

operation.

pname:opType is a elink:VkClusterAccelerationStructureOpTypeNV value

items.name: opMode

specifying the mode of operation.

items.name: opInput

pname:opInput is a slink:VkClusterAccelerationStructureOpInputNV value
