items.name: VK_IMAGE_CREATE_SPARSE_BINDING_BIT
items.text:
ename:VK_IMAGE_CREATE_SPARSE_BINDING_BIT specifies that the image will
be backed using sparse memory binding.

items.name: VK_IMAGE_CREATE_SPARSE_RESIDENCY_BIT
items.text:
ename:VK_IMAGE_CREATE_SPARSE_RESIDENCY_BIT specifies that the image can:
be partially backed using sparse memory binding.
Images created with this flag must: also be created with the
ename:VK_IMAGE_CREATE_SPARSE_BINDING_BIT flag.

items.name: VK_IMAGE_CREATE_SPARSE_ALIASED_BIT
items.text:
ename:VK_IMAGE_CREATE_SPARSE_ALIASED_BIT specifies that the image will
be backed using sparse memory binding with memory ranges that might also
simultaneously be backing another image (or another portion of the same
image).
Images created with this flag must: also be created with the
ename:VK_IMAGE_CREATE_SPARSE_BINDING_BIT flag.

items.name: VK_IMAGE_CREATE_MUTABLE_FORMAT_BIT
items.text:
ename:VK_IMAGE_CREATE_MUTABLE_FORMAT_BIT specifies that the image can:
be used to create a sname:VkImageView with a different format from the
image.
For <<formats-multiplanar, multi-planar formats>>,
ename:VK_IMAGE_CREATE_MUTABLE_FORMAT_BIT specifies that a
sname:VkImageView can be created of a _plane_ of the image.

items.name: VK_IMAGE_CREATE_CUBE_COMPATIBLE_BIT
items.text:
ename:VK_IMAGE_CREATE_CUBE_COMPATIBLE_BIT specifies that the image can:
be used to create a sname:VkImageView of type
ename:VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_CUBE or ename:VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_CUBE_ARRAY.

items.name: VK_IMAGE_CREATE_2D_ARRAY_COMPATIBLE_BIT
items.text:
ename:VK_IMAGE_CREATE_2D_ARRAY_COMPATIBLE_BIT specifies that the image
can: be used to create a sname:VkImageView of type
ename:VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_2D or ename:VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_2D_ARRAY.

items.name: VK_IMAGE_CREATE_2D_VIEW_COMPATIBLE_BIT_EXT
items.text:
ename:VK_IMAGE_CREATE_2D_VIEW_COMPATIBLE_BIT_EXT specifies that the
image can: be used to create a sname:VkImageView of type
ename:VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_2D.

items.name: VK_IMAGE_CREATE_PROTECTED_BIT
items.text:
ename:VK_IMAGE_CREATE_PROTECTED_BIT specifies that the image is a
protected image.

items.name: VK_IMAGE_CREATE_SPLIT_INSTANCE_BIND_REGIONS_BIT
items.text:
ename:VK_IMAGE_CREATE_SPLIT_INSTANCE_BIND_REGIONS_BIT specifies that the
image can: be used with a non-zero value of the
pname:splitInstanceBindRegionCount member of a
slink:VkBindImageMemoryDeviceGroupInfo structure passed into
flink:vkBindImageMemory2.
This flag also has the effect of making the image use the standard
sparse image block dimensions.

items.name: VK_IMAGE_CREATE_BLOCK_TEXEL_VIEW_COMPATIBLE_BIT
items.text:
ename:VK_IMAGE_CREATE_BLOCK_TEXEL_VIEW_COMPATIBLE_BIT specifies that the
image having a compressed format can: be used to create a
sname:VkImageView with an uncompressed format where each texel in the
image view corresponds to a compressed texel block of the image.

items.name: VK_IMAGE_CREATE_EXTENDED_USAGE_BIT
items.text:
ename:VK_IMAGE_CREATE_EXTENDED_USAGE_BIT specifies that the image can:
be created with usage flags that are not supported for the format the
image is created with but are supported for at least one format a
sname:VkImageView created from the image can: have.

items.name: VK_IMAGE_CREATE_DISJOINT_BIT
items.text:
ename:VK_IMAGE_CREATE_DISJOINT_BIT specifies that an image with a
<<formats-multiplanar, multi-planar format>> must: have each plane
separately bound to memory, rather than having a single memory binding
for the whole image; the presence of this bit distinguishes a _disjoint
image_ from an image without this bit set.

items.name: VK_IMAGE_CREATE_ALIAS_BIT
items.text:
ename:VK_IMAGE_CREATE_ALIAS_BIT specifies that two images created with
the same creation parameters and aliased to the same memory can:
interpret the contents of the memory consistently with each other,
subject to the rules described in the <<resources-memory-aliasing,Memory
Aliasing>> section.
This flag further specifies that each plane of a _disjoint_ image can:
share an in-memory non-linear representation with single-plane images,
and that a single-plane image can: share an in-memory non-linear
representation with a plane of a multi-planar disjoint image, according
to the rules in <<formats-compatible-planes>>.
If the pname:pNext chain includes a
slink:VkExternalMemoryImageCreateInfo
or
slink:VkExternalMemoryImageCreateInfoNV
structure whose pname:handleTypes member is not `0`, it is as if
ename:VK_IMAGE_CREATE_ALIAS_BIT is set.

items.name: VK_IMAGE_CREATE_SAMPLE_LOCATIONS_COMPATIBLE_DEPTH_BIT_EXT
items.text:
ename:VK_IMAGE_CREATE_SAMPLE_LOCATIONS_COMPATIBLE_DEPTH_BIT_EXT
specifies that an image with a depth or depth/stencil format can: be
used with custom sample locations when used as a depth/stencil
attachment.

items.name: VK_IMAGE_CREATE_CORNER_SAMPLED_BIT_NV
items.text:
ename:VK_IMAGE_CREATE_CORNER_SAMPLED_BIT_NV specifies that the image is
a <<resources-images-corner-sampled,corner-sampled image>>.

items.name: VK_IMAGE_CREATE_SUBSAMPLED_BIT_EXT
items.text:
ename:VK_IMAGE_CREATE_SUBSAMPLED_BIT_EXT specifies that an image can: be
in a subsampled format which may: be more optimal when written as an
attachment by a render pass that has a fragment density map attachment.
Accessing a subsampled image has additional considerations:
** Image data read as an image sampler will have undefined: values if the
sampler was not created with pname:flags containing
ename:VK_SAMPLER_CREATE_SUBSAMPLED_BIT_EXT or was not sampled through
a combined <<VkDescriptorSetAndBindingMappingEXT, embedded sampler and
image mapping>> if using descriptor heaps, or
the use of a combined image sampler with an immutable sampler in
sname:VkDescriptorSetLayoutBinding.
** Image data read with an input attachment will have undefined: values if
the contents were not written as an attachment in an earlier subpass of
the same render pass.
** Image data read as an image sampler in the fragment shader will be
additionally be read by the device during
ename:VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_VERTEX_SHADER_BIT if
<<limits-subsampledCoarseReconstructionEarlyAccess,
sname:VkPhysicalDeviceFragmentDensityMap2PropertiesEXT::pname:subsampledCoarseReconstructionEarlyAccess>>
is ename:VK_TRUE and the sampler was created with pname:flags
containing
ename:VK_SAMPLER_CREATE_SUBSAMPLED_COARSE_RECONSTRUCTION_BIT_EXT.
** Image data read with load operations are resampled to the fragment
density of the render pass if <<limits-subsampledLoads,
sname:VkPhysicalDeviceFragmentDensityMap2PropertiesEXT::pname:subsampledLoads>>
is ename:VK_TRUE.
Otherwise, values of image data are undefined:.
** Image contents outside of the render area take on undefined: values if
the image is stored as a render pass attachment.

items.name: VK_IMAGE_CREATE_FRAGMENT_DENSITY_MAP_OFFSET_BIT_EXT
items.text:
ename:VK_IMAGE_CREATE_FRAGMENT_DENSITY_MAP_OFFSET_BIT_EXT specifies that
an image can: be used in a render pass with non-zero
<<renderpass-fragmentdensitymapoffsets,fragment density map offsets>>.
In a render pass with non-zero offsets, fragment density map
attachments, input attachments, color attachments, depth/stencil
attachment, resolve attachments, and preserve attachments must: be
created with ename:VK_IMAGE_CREATE_FRAGMENT_DENSITY_MAP_OFFSET_BIT_EXT.

items.name: VK_IMAGE_CREATE_DESCRIPTOR_BUFFER_CAPTURE_REPLAY_BIT_EXT
items.text:
ename:VK_IMAGE_CREATE_DESCRIPTOR_BUFFER_CAPTURE_REPLAY_BIT_EXT specifies
that the image can: be used with descriptor buffers when capturing and
replaying (e.g. for trace capture and replay), see
slink:VkOpaqueCaptureDescriptorDataCreateInfoEXT for more detail.

items.name: VK_IMAGE_CREATE_MULTISAMPLED_RENDER_TO_SINGLE_SAMPLED_BIT_EXT
items.text:
ename:VK_IMAGE_CREATE_MULTISAMPLED_RENDER_TO_SINGLE_SAMPLED_BIT_EXT
specifies that an image can: be used with
<<multisampled-render-to-single-sampled,multisampled rendering as a
single-sampled render pass attachment>>

items.name: VK_IMAGE_CREATE_ALIAS_SINGLE_LAYER_DESCRIPTOR_BIT_KHR
items.text:
ename:VK_IMAGE_CREATE_ALIAS_SINGLE_LAYER_DESCRIPTOR_BIT_KHR specifies
that a single layer image view created from this image can be accessed
with both code:Arrayed equal to 0 and code:Arrayed equal to 1 in a
shader.
If accessed with code:Arrayed equal to 1 in a shader, and
slink:VkImageViewCreateInfo::pname:viewType is
ename:VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_1D or ename:VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_2D, the image is
treated as having an array size of `1`, and
pname:subresourceRange.baseArrayLayer is accessed.
If accessed with code:Arrayed equal to 0 in a shader, and
slink:VkImageViewCreateInfo::pname:viewType is
ename:VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_1D_ARRAY or ename:VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_2D_ARRAY,
the descriptor is accessed as-if the view was created with
ename:VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_1D or ename:VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_2D respectively.
Cube map view aliasing is not included by this flag bit.
Also, image views created with a <<formats-multiplanar, multi-planar
format>> can: not alias like this.

items.name: VK_IMAGE_CREATE_VIDEO_PROFILE_INDEPENDENT_BIT_KHR
items.text:
ename:VK_IMAGE_CREATE_VIDEO_PROFILE_INDEPENDENT_BIT_KHR specifies that
the image can: be used in <<video-coding,video coding operations>>
without having to specify at image creation time the set of video
profiles the image will be used with, except for images used only as
<<dpb,DPB>> pictures, as long as the image is otherwise
<<video-profile-compatibility,compatible>> with the video profile in
question.
+
[NOTE]
====
This enables exchanging video picture data without additional copies or
conversions when used as:

  * <<decode-output-picture,Decode output pictures>>, regardless of the
    video profile used to produce them.
  * <<encode-input-picture,Encode input pictures>>, regardless of the video
    profile used to consume them.

This includes images created with both
ename:VK_IMAGE_USAGE_VIDEO_DECODE_DST_BIT_KHR and
ename:VK_IMAGE_USAGE_VIDEO_DECODE_DPB_BIT_KHR, which is necessary to use the
same video picture as the <<reconstructed-picture,reconstructed picture>>
and <<decode-output-picture,decode output picture>> in a video decode
operation on implementations supporting
ename:VK_VIDEO_DECODE_CAPABILITY_DPB_AND_OUTPUT_COINCIDE_BIT_KHR.

However, images with only DPB usage remain tied to the video profiles the
image was created with, as the data layout of such DPB-only images may: be
implementation- and codec-dependent.

If an application would like to share or reuse the device memory backing
such images (e.g. for the purposes of temporal aliasing), then it should:
create separate image objects for each video profile and bind them to the
same underlying device memory range, similar to how memory resources can: be
shared across separate video sessions or any other memory-backed resource.
====

pages.name: VkImageCreateFlagBits

pages.desc: Bitmask specifying additional parameters of an image

items.name: VK_IMAGE_CREATE_2_SPARSE_BINDING_BIT_KHR
items.text:
ename:VK_IMAGE_CREATE_2_SPARSE_BINDING_BIT_KHR specifies that the image
will be backed using sparse memory binding.

items.name: VK_IMAGE_CREATE_2_SPARSE_RESIDENCY_BIT_KHR
items.text:
ename:VK_IMAGE_CREATE_2_SPARSE_RESIDENCY_BIT_KHR specifies that the
image can: be partially backed using sparse memory binding.
Images created with this flag must: also be created with the
ename:VK_IMAGE_CREATE_2_SPARSE_BINDING_BIT_KHR flag.

items.name: VK_IMAGE_CREATE_2_SPARSE_ALIASED_BIT_KHR
items.text:
ename:VK_IMAGE_CREATE_2_SPARSE_ALIASED_BIT_KHR specifies that the image
will be backed using sparse memory binding with memory ranges that might
also simultaneously be backing another image (or another portion of the
same image).
Images created with this flag must: also be created with the
ename:VK_IMAGE_CREATE_2_SPARSE_BINDING_BIT_KHR flag.

items.name: VK_IMAGE_CREATE_2_MUTABLE_FORMAT_BIT_KHR
items.text:
ename:VK_IMAGE_CREATE_2_MUTABLE_FORMAT_BIT_KHR specifies that the image
can: be used to create a sname:VkImageView with a different format from
the image.
For <<formats-multiplanar, multi-planar formats>>,
ename:VK_IMAGE_CREATE_2_MUTABLE_FORMAT_BIT_KHR specifies that a
sname:VkImageView can be created of a _plane_ of the image.

items.name: VK_IMAGE_CREATE_2_CUBE_COMPATIBLE_BIT_KHR
items.text:
ename:VK_IMAGE_CREATE_2_CUBE_COMPATIBLE_BIT_KHR specifies that the image
can: be used to create a sname:VkImageView of type
ename:VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_CUBE or ename:VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_CUBE_ARRAY.

items.name: VK_IMAGE_CREATE_2_2D_ARRAY_COMPATIBLE_BIT_KHR
items.text:
ename:VK_IMAGE_CREATE_2_2D_ARRAY_COMPATIBLE_BIT_KHR specifies that the
image can: be used to create a sname:VkImageView of type
ename:VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_2D or ename:VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_2D_ARRAY.

items.name: VK_IMAGE_CREATE_2_2D_VIEW_COMPATIBLE_BIT_EXT
items.text:
ename:VK_IMAGE_CREATE_2_2D_VIEW_COMPATIBLE_BIT_EXT specifies that the
image can: be used to create a sname:VkImageView of type
ename:VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_2D.

items.name: VK_IMAGE_CREATE_2_PROTECTED_BIT_KHR
items.text:
ename:VK_IMAGE_CREATE_2_PROTECTED_BIT_KHR specifies that the image is a
protected image.

items.name: VK_IMAGE_CREATE_2_SPLIT_INSTANCE_BIND_REGIONS_BIT_KHR
items.text:
ename:VK_IMAGE_CREATE_2_SPLIT_INSTANCE_BIND_REGIONS_BIT_KHR specifies
that the image can: be used with a non-zero value of the
pname:splitInstanceBindRegionCount member of a
slink:VkBindImageMemoryDeviceGroupInfo structure passed into
flink:vkBindImageMemory2.
This flag also has the effect of making the image use the standard
sparse image block dimensions.

items.name: VK_IMAGE_CREATE_2_BLOCK_TEXEL_VIEW_COMPATIBLE_BIT_KHR
items.text:
ename:VK_IMAGE_CREATE_2_BLOCK_TEXEL_VIEW_COMPATIBLE_BIT_KHR specifies
that the image having a compressed format can: be used to create a
sname:VkImageView with an uncompressed format where each texel in the
image view corresponds to a compressed texel block of the image.

items.name: VK_IMAGE_CREATE_2_EXTENDED_USAGE_BIT_KHR
items.text:
ename:VK_IMAGE_CREATE_2_EXTENDED_USAGE_BIT_KHR specifies that the image
can: be created with usage flags that are not supported for the format
the image is created with but are supported for at least one format a
sname:VkImageView created from the image can: have.

items.name: VK_IMAGE_CREATE_2_DISJOINT_BIT_KHR
items.text:
ename:VK_IMAGE_CREATE_2_DISJOINT_BIT_KHR specifies that an image with a
<<formats-multiplanar, multi-planar format>> must: have each plane
separately bound to memory, rather than having a single memory binding
for the whole image; the presence of this bit distinguishes a _disjoint
image_ from an image without this bit set.

items.name: VK_IMAGE_CREATE_2_ALIAS_BIT_KHR
items.text:
ename:VK_IMAGE_CREATE_2_ALIAS_BIT_KHR specifies that two images created
with the same creation parameters and aliased to the same memory can:
interpret the contents of the memory consistently with each other,
subject to the rules described in the <<resources-memory-aliasing,Memory
Aliasing>> section.
This flag further specifies that each plane of a _disjoint_ image can:
share an in-memory non-linear representation with single-plane images,
and that a single-plane image can: share an in-memory non-linear
representation with a plane of a multi-planar disjoint image, according
to the rules in <<formats-compatible-planes>>.
If the pname:pNext chain includes a
slink:VkExternalMemoryImageCreateInfo
or
slink:VkExternalMemoryImageCreateInfoNV
structure whose pname:handleTypes member is not `0`, it is as if
ename:VK_IMAGE_CREATE_2_ALIAS_BIT_KHR is set.

items.name: VK_IMAGE_CREATE_2_SAMPLE_LOCATIONS_COMPATIBLE_DEPTH_BIT_EXT
items.text:
ename:VK_IMAGE_CREATE_2_SAMPLE_LOCATIONS_COMPATIBLE_DEPTH_BIT_EXT
specifies that an image with a depth or depth/stencil format can: be
used with custom sample locations when used as a depth/stencil
attachment.

items.name: VK_IMAGE_CREATE_2_CORNER_SAMPLED_BIT_NV
items.text:
ename:VK_IMAGE_CREATE_2_CORNER_SAMPLED_BIT_NV specifies that the image
is a <<resources-images-corner-sampled,corner-sampled image>>.

items.name: VK_IMAGE_CREATE_2_SUBSAMPLED_BIT_EXT
items.text:
ename:VK_IMAGE_CREATE_2_SUBSAMPLED_BIT_EXT specifies that an image can:
be in a subsampled format which may: be more optimal when written as an
attachment by a render pass that has a fragment density map attachment.
Accessing a subsampled image has additional considerations:
** Image data read as an image sampler will have undefined: values if the
sampler was not created with pname:flags containing
ename:VK_SAMPLER_CREATE_SUBSAMPLED_BIT_EXT or was not sampled through
the use of a combined image sampler with an immutable sampler in
sname:VkDescriptorSetLayoutBinding.
** Image data read with an input attachment will have undefined: values if
the contents were not written as an attachment in an earlier subpass of
the same render pass.
** Image data read as an image sampler in the fragment shader will be
additionally be read by the device during
ename:VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_VERTEX_SHADER_BIT if
<<limits-subsampledCoarseReconstructionEarlyAccess,
sname:VkPhysicalDeviceFragmentDensityMap2PropertiesEXT::pname:subsampledCoarseReconstructionEarlyAccess>>
is ename:VK_TRUE and the sampler was created with pname:flags
containing
ename:VK_SAMPLER_CREATE_SUBSAMPLED_COARSE_RECONSTRUCTION_BIT_EXT.
** Image data read with load operations are resampled to the fragment
density of the render pass if <<limits-subsampledLoads,
sname:VkPhysicalDeviceFragmentDensityMap2PropertiesEXT::pname:subsampledLoads>>
is ename:VK_TRUE.
Otherwise, values of image data are undefined:.
** Image contents outside of the render area take on undefined: values if
the image is stored as a render pass attachment.

items.name: VK_IMAGE_CREATE_2_FRAGMENT_DENSITY_MAP_OFFSET_BIT_EXT
items.text:
ename:VK_IMAGE_CREATE_2_FRAGMENT_DENSITY_MAP_OFFSET_BIT_EXT specifies
that an image can: be used in a render pass with non-zero
<<renderpass-fragmentdensitymapoffsets,fragment density map offsets>>.
In a render pass with non-zero offsets, fragment density map
attachments, input attachments, color attachments, depth/stencil
attachment, resolve attachments, and preserve attachments must: be
created with
ename:VK_IMAGE_CREATE_2_FRAGMENT_DENSITY_MAP_OFFSET_BIT_EXT.

items.name: VK_IMAGE_CREATE_2_DESCRIPTOR_BUFFER_CAPTURE_REPLAY_BIT_EXT
items.text:
ename:VK_IMAGE_CREATE_2_DESCRIPTOR_BUFFER_CAPTURE_REPLAY_BIT_EXT
specifies that the image can: be used with descriptor buffers when
capturing and replaying (e.g. for trace capture and replay), see
slink:VkOpaqueCaptureDescriptorDataCreateInfoEXT for more detail.

items.name: VK_IMAGE_CREATE_2_MULTISAMPLED_RENDER_TO_SINGLE_SAMPLED_BIT_EXT
items.text:
ename:VK_IMAGE_CREATE_2_MULTISAMPLED_RENDER_TO_SINGLE_SAMPLED_BIT_EXT
specifies that an image can: be used with
<<multisampled-render-to-single-sampled,multisampled rendering as a
single-sampled framebuffer attachment>>

items.name: VK_IMAGE_CREATE_2_VIDEO_PROFILE_INDEPENDENT_BIT_KHR
items.text:
ename:VK_IMAGE_CREATE_2_VIDEO_PROFILE_INDEPENDENT_BIT_KHR specifies that
the image can: be used in <<video-coding,video coding operations>>
without having to specify at image creation time the set of video
profiles the image will be used with, except for images used only as
<<dpb,DPB>> pictures, as long as the image is otherwise
<<video-profile-compatibility,compatible>> with the video profile in
question.
+
[NOTE]
====
This enables exchanging video picture data without additional copies or
conversions when used as:

  * <<decode-output-picture,Decode output pictures>>, regardless of the
    video profile used to produce them.
  * <<encode-input-picture,Encode input pictures>>, regardless of the video
    profile used to consume them.

This includes images created with both
ename:VK_IMAGE_USAGE_VIDEO_DECODE_DST_BIT_KHR and
ename:VK_IMAGE_USAGE_VIDEO_DECODE_DPB_BIT_KHR, which is necessary to use the
same video picture as the <<reconstructed-picture,reconstructed picture>>
and <<decode-output-picture,decode output picture>> in a video decode
operation on implementations supporting
ename:VK_VIDEO_DECODE_CAPABILITY_DPB_AND_OUTPUT_COINCIDE_BIT_KHR.

However, images with only DPB usage remain tied to the video profiles the
image was created with, as the data layout of such DPB-only images may: be
implementation- and codec-dependent.

If an application would like to share or reuse the device memory backing
such images (e.g. for the purposes of temporal aliasing), then it should:
create separate image objects for each video profile and bind them to the
same underlying device memory range, similar to how memory resources can: be
shared across separate video sessions or any other memory-backed resource.
====

dimensionality of the image.
Layers in array textures do not count as a dimension for the purposes of
the image type.

pname:format is a elink:VkFormat describing the format and type of the

mode of the image when it will be accessed by multiple queue families.

that will access this image.
It is ignored if pname:sharingMode is not

items.name: initialLayout

initial elink:VkImageLayout of all image subresources of the image.
See <<resources-image-layouts,Image Layouts>>.

items.name: maxExtent
items.text:
pname:maxExtent are the maximum image dimensions.
See the <<features-extentperimagetype, Allowed Extent Values>> section
below for how these values are constrained by pname:type.

items.name: maxMipLevels
items.text:
pname:maxMipLevels is the maximum number of mipmap levels.
pname:maxMipLevels must: be equal to the number of levels in the
complete mipmap chain based on the [eq]#pname:maxExtent.width#,
[eq]#pname:maxExtent.height#, and [eq]#pname:maxExtent.depth#, except
when one of the following conditions is true, in which case it may:
instead be `1`:
** fname:vkGetPhysicalDeviceImageFormatProperties::pname:tiling was
ename:VK_IMAGE_TILING_LINEAR
** slink:VkPhysicalDeviceImageFormatInfo2::pname:tiling was
ename:VK_IMAGE_TILING_DRM_FORMAT_MODIFIER_EXT
** the slink:VkPhysicalDeviceImageFormatInfo2::pname:pNext chain included
a slink:VkPhysicalDeviceExternalImageFormatInfo structure with a handle
type included in the pname:handleTypes member for which mipmap image
support is not required
** image pname:format is one of the
<<formats-requiring-sampler-ycbcr-conversion, formats that require a
sampler {YCbCr} conversion>>
** pname:flags contains ename:VK_IMAGE_CREATE_SUBSAMPLED_BIT_EXT

items.name: maxArrayLayers
items.text:
pname:maxArrayLayers is the maximum number of array layers.
pname:maxArrayLayers must: be no less than
slink:VkPhysicalDeviceLimits::pname:maxImageArrayLayers, except when one
of the following conditions is true, in which case it may: instead be
`1`:
** pname:tiling is ename:VK_IMAGE_TILING_LINEAR
** pname:tiling is ename:VK_IMAGE_TILING_OPTIMAL and pname:type is
ename:VK_IMAGE_TYPE_3D
** pname:format is one of the
<<formats-requiring-sampler-ycbcr-conversion, formats that require a
sampler {YCbCr} conversion>>

items.name: sampleCounts
items.text:
pname:sampleCounts is a bitmask of elink:VkSampleCountFlagBits
specifying all the supported sample counts for this image as described
<<features-supported-sample-counts, below>>.

items.name: maxResourceSize
items.text:
pname:maxResourceSize is an upper bound on the total image size in
bytes, inclusive of all image subresources.
Implementations may: have an address space limit on total size of a
resource, which is advertised by this property.
pname:maxResourceSize must: be at least 2^31^.

pages.name: VkImageFormatProperties2

pages.desc: Layout of image and image subresources

items.name: VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED
items.text:
ename:VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED specifies that the layout is unknown.
Image memory cannot: be transitioned into this layout.
This layout can: be used as the pname:initialLayout member of
slink:VkImageCreateInfo.
This layout can: be used in place of the current image layout in a
layout transition, but doing so will cause the contents of the image's
memory to be undefined:.

items.name: VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_PREINITIALIZED
items.text:
ename:VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_PREINITIALIZED specifies that a linear image's
memory is in a defined layout and can: be populated by data, but that it
has not yet been initialized by the driver.
Image memory cannot: be transitioned into this layout.
This layout can: be used as the pname:initialLayout member of
slink:VkImageCreateInfo when pname:tiling is
ename:VK_IMAGE_TILING_LINEAR.
This layout is intended to be used as the initial layout for an image
whose contents are written by the host, and hence the data can: be
written to memory immediately, without first executing a layout
transition.

items.name: VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL
items.text:
ename:VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL supports all types of device access,
unless specified otherwise.

items.name: VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_ZERO_INITIALIZED_EXT
items.text:
ename:VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_ZERO_INITIALIZED_EXT specifies that an image's
memory is in a defined layout and is zeroed, but that it has not yet
been initialized by the driver.
Image memory cannot: be transitioned into this layout.
This layout can: be used as the pname:initialLayout member of
slink:VkImageCreateInfo.
This layout is intended to be used as the initial layout for an image
whose contents are already zeroed, either from being explicitly set to
zero by an application or from being allocated with
ename:VK_MEMORY_ALLOCATE_ZERO_INITIALIZE_BIT_EXT.

items.name: VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL
items.text:
ename:VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL specifies a layout that must:
only be used with attachment accesses in the graphics pipeline.

items.name: VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL
items.text:
ename:VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL specifies a layout allowing read
only access as an attachment, or in shaders as a sampled image, combined
image/sampler, or input attachment.

items.name: VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL
items.text:
ename:VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL must: only be used as a
color or resolve attachment in a sname:VkFramebuffer.
This layout is valid only for image subresources of images created with
the ename:VK_IMAGE_USAGE_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_BIT usage flag set.

items.name: VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_DEPTH_STENCIL_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL
items.text:
ename:VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_DEPTH_STENCIL_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL specifies a
layout for both the depth and stencil aspects of a depth/stencil format
image allowing read and write access as a depth/stencil attachment.
It is equivalent to ename:VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_DEPTH_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL and
ename:VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_STENCIL_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL.

items.name: VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_DEPTH_STENCIL_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL
items.text:
ename:VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_DEPTH_STENCIL_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL specifies a layout
for both the depth and stencil aspects of a depth/stencil format image
allowing read only access as a depth/stencil attachment or in shaders as
a sampled image, combined image/sampler, or input attachment.
It is equivalent to ename:VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_DEPTH_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL and
ename:VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_STENCIL_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL.

items.name: VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_DEPTH_READ_ONLY_STENCIL_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL
items.text:
ename:VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_DEPTH_READ_ONLY_STENCIL_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL
specifies a layout for depth/stencil format images allowing read and
write access to the stencil aspect as a stencil attachment, and read
only access to the depth aspect as a depth attachment or in shaders as a
sampled image, combined image/sampler, or input attachment.
It is equivalent to ename:VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_DEPTH_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL and
ename:VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_STENCIL_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL.

items.name: VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_DEPTH_ATTACHMENT_STENCIL_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL
items.text:
ename:VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_DEPTH_ATTACHMENT_STENCIL_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL
specifies a layout for depth/stencil format images allowing read and
write access to the depth aspect as a depth attachment, and read only
access to the stencil aspect as a stencil attachment or in shaders as a
sampled image, combined image/sampler, or input attachment.
It is equivalent to ename:VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_DEPTH_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL and
ename:VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_STENCIL_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL.

items.name: VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_DEPTH_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL
items.text:
ename:VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_DEPTH_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL specifies a layout for
the depth aspect of a depth/stencil format image allowing read and write
access as a depth attachment.

items.name: VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_DEPTH_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL
items.text:
ename:VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_DEPTH_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL specifies a layout for the
depth aspect of a depth/stencil format image allowing read-only access
as a depth attachment or in shaders as a sampled image, combined
image/sampler, or input attachment.

items.name: VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_STENCIL_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL
items.text:
ename:VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_STENCIL_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL specifies a layout for
the stencil aspect of a depth/stencil format image allowing read and
write access as a stencil attachment.

items.name: VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_STENCIL_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL
items.text:
ename:VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_STENCIL_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL specifies a layout for
the stencil aspect of a depth/stencil format image allowing read-only
access as a stencil attachment or in shaders as a sampled image,
combined image/sampler, or input attachment.

items.name: VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL
items.text:
ename:VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL specifies a layout
allowing read-only access in a shader as a sampled image, combined
image/sampler, or input attachment.
This layout is valid only for image subresources of images created with
the ename:VK_IMAGE_USAGE_SAMPLED_BIT or
ename:VK_IMAGE_USAGE_INPUT_ATTACHMENT_BIT usage bits enabled.

items.name: VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL
items.text:
ename:VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL must: only be used as a
source image of a transfer command (see the definition of
<<synchronization-pipeline-stages-transfer,
ename:VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TRANSFER_BIT>>).
This layout is valid only for image subresources of images created with
the ename:VK_IMAGE_USAGE_TRANSFER_SRC_BIT usage flag set.

items.name: VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL
items.text:
ename:VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL must: only be used as a
destination image of a transfer command.
This layout is valid only for image subresources of images created with
the ename:VK_IMAGE_USAGE_TRANSFER_DST_BIT usage flag set.

items.name: VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_PRESENT_SRC_KHR
items.text:
ename:VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_PRESENT_SRC_KHR must: only be used for presenting
a presentable image for display.

items.name: VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_SHARED_PRESENT_KHR
items.text:
ename:VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_SHARED_PRESENT_KHR is valid only for shared
presentable images, and must: be used for any usage the image supports.

items.name: VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_FRAGMENT_SHADING_RATE_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL_KHR
items.text:
ename:VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_FRAGMENT_SHADING_RATE_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL_KHR must:
only be used as a
<<primsrast-fragment-shading-rate-attachment, fragment shading rate
attachment>>
or
<<primsrast-shading-rate-image, shading rate image>>.
This layout is valid only for image subresources of images created with
the ename:VK_IMAGE_USAGE_FRAGMENT_SHADING_RATE_ATTACHMENT_BIT_KHR usage
flag set.

items.name: VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_FRAGMENT_DENSITY_MAP_OPTIMAL_EXT
items.text:
ename:VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_FRAGMENT_DENSITY_MAP_OPTIMAL_EXT must: only be
used as a fragment density map attachment in a sname:VkRenderPass.
This layout is valid only for image subresources of images created with
the ename:VK_IMAGE_USAGE_FRAGMENT_DENSITY_MAP_BIT_EXT usage flag set.

items.name: VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_VIDEO_DECODE_DST_KHR
items.text:
ename:VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_VIDEO_DECODE_DST_KHR must: only be used as a
<<decode-output-picture,decode output picture>> in a
<<video-decode-operations,video decode operation>>.
This layout is valid only for image subresources of images created with
the ename:VK_IMAGE_USAGE_VIDEO_DECODE_DST_BIT_KHR usage flag set.

items.name: VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_VIDEO_DECODE_SRC_KHR
items.text: ename:VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_VIDEO_DECODE_SRC_KHR is reserved for future use.

items.name: VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_VIDEO_DECODE_DPB_KHR
items.text:
ename:VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_VIDEO_DECODE_DPB_KHR must: only be used as an
output <<reconstructed-picture,reconstructed picture>> or an input
<<reference-picture,reference picture>> in a <<video-decode-operations,
video decode operation>>.
This layout is valid only for image subresources of images created with
the ename:VK_IMAGE_USAGE_VIDEO_DECODE_DPB_BIT_KHR usage flag set.

items.name: VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_VIDEO_ENCODE_DST_KHR
items.text: ename:VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_VIDEO_ENCODE_DST_KHR is reserved for future use.

items.name: VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_VIDEO_ENCODE_SRC_KHR
items.text:
ename:VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_VIDEO_ENCODE_SRC_KHR must: only be used as an
<<encode-input-picture,encode input picture>> in a
<<video-encode-operations,video encode operation>>.
This layout is valid only for image subresources of images created with
the ename:VK_IMAGE_USAGE_VIDEO_ENCODE_SRC_BIT_KHR usage flag set.

items.name: VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_VIDEO_ENCODE_DPB_KHR
items.text:
ename:VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_VIDEO_ENCODE_DPB_KHR must: only be used as an
output <<reconstructed-picture,reconstructed picture>> or an input
<<reference-picture,reference picture>> in a <<video-encode-operations,
video encode operation>>.
This layout is valid only for image subresources of images created with
the ename:VK_IMAGE_USAGE_VIDEO_ENCODE_DPB_BIT_KHR usage flag set.

items.name: VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_ATTACHMENT_FEEDBACK_LOOP_OPTIMAL_EXT
items.text:
ename:VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_ATTACHMENT_FEEDBACK_LOOP_OPTIMAL_EXT must: only be
used as either a color attachment or depth/stencil attachment and/or
read-only access in a shader as a sampled image, combined image/sampler,
or input attachment.
This layout is valid only for image subresources of images created with
the ename:VK_IMAGE_USAGE_ATTACHMENT_FEEDBACK_LOOP_BIT_EXT usage flag
set, and either the ename:VK_IMAGE_USAGE_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_BIT or
ename:VK_IMAGE_USAGE_DEPTH_STENCIL_ATTACHMENT_BIT usage flags set, and
either the ename:VK_IMAGE_USAGE_INPUT_ATTACHMENT_BIT or
ename:VK_IMAGE_USAGE_SAMPLED_BIT usage flags set

items.name: VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_RENDERING_LOCAL_READ
items.text:
ename:VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_RENDERING_LOCAL_READ must: only be used as either
a storage image, or a color or depth/stencil attachment and an input
attachment.
This layout is valid only for image subresources of images created with
either the ename:VK_IMAGE_USAGE_STORAGE_BIT usage flag set, or both the
ename:VK_IMAGE_USAGE_INPUT_ATTACHMENT_BIT and either of the
ename:VK_IMAGE_USAGE_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_BIT or
ename:VK_IMAGE_USAGE_DEPTH_STENCIL_ATTACHMENT_BIT usage flags set.

items.name: VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_VIDEO_ENCODE_QUANTIZATION_MAP_KHR
items.text:
ename:VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_VIDEO_ENCODE_QUANTIZATION_MAP_KHR must: only be
used as a <<encode-quantization-map,quantization map>> in a
<<video-encode-operations,video encode operation>>.
This layout is valid only for image subresources of images created with
the ename:VK_IMAGE_USAGE_VIDEO_ENCODE_QUANTIZATION_DELTA_MAP_BIT_KHR or
ename:VK_IMAGE_USAGE_VIDEO_ENCODE_EMPHASIS_MAP_BIT_KHR usage flags set.

items.name: VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TENSOR_ALIASING_ARM
items.text:
ename:VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TENSOR_ALIASING_ARM specifies the layout that an
image created with ename:VK_IMAGE_TILING_OPTIMAL must: be in, if the
<<features-unifiedImageLayouts,pname:unifiedImageLayouts>> feature is
disabled, or may: be in if it is enabled, for it and a tensor bound to
the same aliased range of memory to consistently interpret the data in
memory.
See <<resources-memory-aliasing>> for a complete set of rules for
tensor/image aliasing.
This layout is valid only for image subresources of images created with
the ename:VK_IMAGE_USAGE_TENSOR_ALIASING_BIT_ARM usage flag set.

items.name: sType

structure.

items.name: srcAccessMask
items.text:

<<synchronization-image-layout-transitions, image layout transition>>.

items.name: newLayout

<<synchronization-image-layout-transitions, image layout transition>>.

items.name: srcQueueFamilyIndex
items.text:

<<synchronization-queue-transfers, queue family ownership transfer>>.

items.name: dstQueueFamilyIndex

pname:dstQueueFamilyIndex is the destination queue family for a
<<synchronization-queue-transfers, queue family ownership transfer>>.

items.name: image

items.name: subresourceRange
items.text:
pname:subresourceRange describes the <<resources-image-views, image
subresource range>> within pname:image that is affected by this barrier.

pages.name: VkImagePlaneMemoryRequirementsInfo

pages.desc: Structure specifying an image resolve operation

items.name: srcSubresource
items.text:
pname:srcSubresource and pname:dstSubresource are
slink:VkImageSubresourceLayers structures specifying the image
subresources of the images used for the source and destination image
data, respectively.
Resolve of depth/stencil images is not supported.
slink:VkImageResolve2 can: support resolve of depth/stencil images with
<<features-maintenance10,pname:maintenance10>> instead.

items.name: srcOffset
items.text:
pname:srcOffset and pname:dstOffset select the initial pname:x, pname:y,
and pname:z offsets in texels of the sub-regions of the source and
destination image data.

items.name: extent
items.text:
pname:extent is the size in texels of the source image to resolve in
pname:width, pname:height and pname:depth.

pages.name: VkImageSwapchainCreateInfoKHR

pages.desc: Specifies the tiling arrangement of data in an image

items.name: VK_IMAGE_TILING_OPTIMAL
items.text:
ename:VK_IMAGE_TILING_OPTIMAL specifies optimal tiling (texels are laid
out in an implementation-dependent arrangement, for more efficient
memory access).

items.name: VK_IMAGE_TILING_LINEAR
items.text:
ename:VK_IMAGE_TILING_LINEAR specifies linear tiling (texels are laid
out in memory in row-major order, possibly with some padding on each
row).

items.name: VK_IMAGE_TILING_DRM_FORMAT_MODIFIER_EXT
items.text:
ename:VK_IMAGE_TILING_DRM_FORMAT_MODIFIER_EXT specifies that the image's
tiling is defined by a <<glossary-drm-format-modifier,Linux DRM format
modifier>>.
The modifier is specified at image creation with
slink:VkImageDrmFormatModifierListCreateInfoEXT or
slink:VkImageDrmFormatModifierExplicitCreateInfoEXT, and can: be queried
with flink:vkGetImageDrmFormatModifierPropertiesEXT.

pages.name: VkImageTiling

pages.desc: Specifies additional creation parameters for image tiling

items.name: sType
items.text: pname:sType is a elink:VkStructureType value identifying this structure.

items.name: pNext
items.text:
pname:pNext is `NULL` or a pointer to a structure extending this
structure.

items.name: imageTiling
items.text:

pages.desc: Bitmask specifying allowed usage of an indirect commands layout

items.name: VK_INDIRECT_COMMANDS_LAYOUT_USAGE_EXPLICIT_PREPROCESS_BIT_EXT
items.text:
ename:VK_INDIRECT_COMMANDS_LAYOUT_USAGE_EXPLICIT_PREPROCESS_BIT_EXT
specifies that the layout is always used with the manual preprocessing
step through calling flink:vkCmdPreprocessGeneratedCommandsEXT and
executed by flink:vkCmdExecuteGeneratedCommandsEXT with
pname:isPreprocessed set to ename:VK_TRUE.

items.name: VK_INDIRECT_COMMANDS_LAYOUT_USAGE_UNORDERED_SEQUENCES_BIT_EXT
items.text:
ename:VK_INDIRECT_COMMANDS_LAYOUT_USAGE_UNORDERED_SEQUENCES_BIT_EXT
specifies that the processing of sequences will happen at an
implementation-dependent order, which is not guaranteed to be
deterministic using the same input data.
This flag is ignored when the pname:shaderStages is
ename:VK_SHADER_STAGE_COMPUTE_BIT as it is implied that the dispatch
sequence is always unordered.

pages.name: VkIndirectCommandsLayoutUsageFlagBitsEXT

pages.desc: Bitmask specifying allowed usage of an indirect commands layout

items.name: VK_INDIRECT_COMMANDS_LAYOUT_USAGE_EXPLICIT_PREPROCESS_BIT_NV
items.text:
ename:VK_INDIRECT_COMMANDS_LAYOUT_USAGE_EXPLICIT_PREPROCESS_BIT_NV
specifies that the layout is always used with the manual preprocessing
step through calling flink:vkCmdPreprocessGeneratedCommandsNV and
executed by flink:vkCmdExecuteGeneratedCommandsNV with
pname:isPreprocessed set to ename:VK_TRUE.

items.name: VK_INDIRECT_COMMANDS_LAYOUT_USAGE_INDEXED_SEQUENCES_BIT_NV
items.text:
ename:VK_INDIRECT_COMMANDS_LAYOUT_USAGE_INDEXED_SEQUENCES_BIT_NV
specifies that the input data for the sequences is not implicitly
indexed from 0..sequencesUsed, but an application-provided
sname:VkBuffer encoding the index is provided.

items.name: VK_INDIRECT_COMMANDS_LAYOUT_USAGE_UNORDERED_SEQUENCES_BIT_NV
items.text:
ename:VK_INDIRECT_COMMANDS_LAYOUT_USAGE_UNORDERED_SEQUENCES_BIT_NV
specifies that the processing of sequences can: happen at an
implementation-dependent order, which is not guaranteed to be coherent
using the same input data.
This flag is ignored when the pname:pipelineBindPoint is
ename:VK_PIPELINE_BIND_POINT_COMPUTE as it is implied that the dispatch
sequence is always unordered.

items.text: pname:enabledLayerCount is the number of global layers to enable.

pname:ppEnabledLayerNames is a pointer to an array of
pname:enabledLayerCount null-terminated UTF-8 strings containing the
names of layers to enable for the created instance.
The layers are loaded in the order they are listed in this array, with
the first array element being the closest to the application, and the
last array element being the closest to the driver.
See the <<extendingvulkan-layers>> section for further details.

pages.desc: Structure used to mark different points in latency

items.name: VK_LATENCY_MARKER_SIMULATION_START_NV
items.text:
ename:VK_LATENCY_MARKER_SIMULATION_START_NV should: be called at the
start of the simulation execution each frame, but after the call to
fname:vkLatencySleepNV.

items.name: VK_LATENCY_MARKER_SIMULATION_END_NV
items.text:
ename:VK_LATENCY_MARKER_SIMULATION_END_NV should: be called at the end
of the simulation execution each frame.

items.name: VK_LATENCY_MARKER_RENDERSUBMIT_START_NV
items.text:
ename:VK_LATENCY_MARKER_RENDERSUBMIT_START_NV should: be called at the
beginning of the render submission execution each frame.
This should: be wherever Vulkan API calls are made and must: not span
into asynchronous rendering.

items.name: VK_LATENCY_MARKER_RENDERSUBMIT_END_NV
items.text:
ename:VK_LATENCY_MARKER_RENDERSUBMIT_END_NV should: be called at the end
of the render submission execution each frame.

items.name: VK_LATENCY_MARKER_PRESENT_START_NV
items.text:
ename:VK_LATENCY_MARKER_PRESENT_START_NV should: be called just before
the fname:vkQueuePresentKHR call requesting presentation of an
application-rendered frame.

items.name: VK_LATENCY_MARKER_PRESENT_END_NV
items.text:
ename:VK_LATENCY_MARKER_PRESENT_END_NV should: be called when that
fname:vkQueuePresentKHR call returns.
This may be used to delimit workload submissions between
application-rendered frames according to the rules defined in
<<low-latency2-frame-attribution>>.

items.name: VK_LATENCY_MARKER_INPUT_SAMPLE_NV
items.text:
ename:VK_LATENCY_MARKER_INPUT_SAMPLE_NV should: be called just before
the application gathers input data.

items.name: VK_LATENCY_MARKER_TRIGGER_FLASH_NV
items.text:
ename:VK_LATENCY_MARKER_TRIGGER_FLASH_NV should: be called anywhere
between ename:VK_LATENCY_MARKER_SIMULATION_START_NV and
ename:VK_LATENCY_MARKER_SIMULATION_END_NV whenever a left mouse click
occurs.

pname:signalSemaphore is a semaphore that is signaled to indicate that
the application should: resume input sampling work.

resuming sampling work.

structure.

mode.

items.name: lowLatencyBoost
items.text:
pname:lowLatencyBoost allows an application to hint to the GPU to
increase performance to provide additional latency savings at a cost of
increased power consumption.

items.name: minimumIntervalUs
items.text:
pname:minimumIntervalUs is the microseconds between
flink:vkQueuePresentKHR calls for a given swapchain that
flink:vkLatencySleepNV will enforce.

structure.

structure.

pname:presentID is the application-defined identifier of the
application-rendered frame described by this structure.
It is the same value that the application passes to
flink:vkSetLatencyMarkerNV via

enum ename:VK_LATENCY_MARKER_SIMULATION_START_NV.

items.name: simEndTimeUs

pname:simEndTimeUs is the timestamp written when

enum ename:VK_LATENCY_MARKER_SIMULATION_END_NV.

fname:vkSetLatencyMarkerNV is called with the ename:VkLatencyMarkerNV
enum ename:VK_LATENCY_MARKER_RENDERSUBMIT_START_NV.

items.name: renderEndTimeUs

pname:renderEndTimeUs is the timestamp written when
fname:vkSetLatencyMarkerNV is called with the ename:VkLatencyMarkerNV
enum ename:VK_LATENCY_MARKER_RENDERSUBMIT_END_NV.

items.name: presentStartTimeUs

pname:presentStartTimeUs is the timestamp written when
fname:vkSetLatencyMarkerNV is called with the ename:VkLatencyMarkerNV
enum ename:VK_LATENCY_MARKER_PRESENT_START_NV.

items.name: presentEndTimeUs

fname:vkSetLatencyMarkerNV is called with the ename:VkLatencyMarkerNV
enum ename:VK_LATENCY_MARKER_PRESENT_END_NV.

items.name: driverStartTimeUs
items.text:
pname:driverStartTimeUs is the timestamp written when the first
fname:vkQueueSubmit for the frame is called.

items.name: driverEndTimeUs
items.text:
pname:driverEndTimeUs is the timestamp written when the final
fname:vkQueueSubmit hands off from the Vulkan Driver.

items.name: osRenderQueueStartTimeUs
items.text:
pname:osRenderQueueStartTimeUs is the timestamp written when the final
fname:vkQueueSubmit hands off from the Vulkan Driver.

items.name: osRenderQueueEndTimeUs
items.text:
pname:osRenderQueueEndTimeUs is the timestamp written when the first
submission reaches the GPU.

items.name: gpuRenderStartTimeUs
items.text:
pname:gpuRenderStartTimeUs is the timestamp written when the first
submission reaches the GPU.

items.name: gpuRenderEndTimeUs
items.text:
pname:gpuRenderEndTimeUs is the timestamp written when the final
submission finishes on the GPU for the frame.

code:char containing a null-terminated UTF-8 string which is the name of
the layer.

slink:VkInstanceCreateInfo structure to enable this layer for an

containing a null-terminated UTF-8 string which provides additional
details that can: be used by the application to identify the layer.

the setting to configure.

setting.

type indicated by pname:type to configure the layer setting.

setting's type is basetype:VkBool32.

items.name: VK_LINE_RASTERIZATION_MODE_DEFAULT
items.text:
ename:VK_LINE_RASTERIZATION_MODE_DEFAULT is equivalent to
ename:VK_LINE_RASTERIZATION_MODE_RECTANGULAR if
slink:VkPhysicalDeviceLimits::pname:strictLines is ename:VK_TRUE,
otherwise lines are drawn as non-pname:strictLines parallelograms.
Both of these modes are defined in <<primsrast-lines-basic,Basic Line
Segment Rasterization>>.

items.name: VK_LINE_RASTERIZATION_MODE_RECTANGULAR
items.text:
ename:VK_LINE_RASTERIZATION_MODE_RECTANGULAR specifies lines drawn as if
they were rectangles extruded from the line

items.name: VK_LINE_RASTERIZATION_MODE_BRESENHAM
items.text:
ename:VK_LINE_RASTERIZATION_MODE_BRESENHAM specifies lines drawn by
determining which pixel diamonds the line intersects and exits, as
defined in <<primsrast-lines-bresenham,Bresenham Line Segment
Rasterization>>.

items.name: VK_LINE_RASTERIZATION_MODE_RECTANGULAR_SMOOTH
items.text:
ename:VK_LINE_RASTERIZATION_MODE_RECTANGULAR_SMOOTH specifies lines
drawn if they were rectangles extruded from the line, with alpha
falloff, as defined in <<primsrast-lines-smooth,Smooth Lines>>.

items.name: VK_MEMORY_ALLOCATE_DEVICE_MASK_BIT
items.text:
ename:VK_MEMORY_ALLOCATE_DEVICE_MASK_BIT specifies that memory will be
allocated for the devices in
slink:VkMemoryAllocateFlagsInfo::pname:deviceMask.

items.name: VK_MEMORY_ALLOCATE_DEVICE_ADDRESS_BIT
items.text:
ename:VK_MEMORY_ALLOCATE_DEVICE_ADDRESS_BIT specifies that the memory
can: be attached to a buffer object created with the
ename:VK_BUFFER_USAGE_SHADER_DEVICE_ADDRESS_BIT usage flag set.

items.name: VK_MEMORY_ALLOCATE_DEVICE_ADDRESS_CAPTURE_REPLAY_BIT
items.text:
ename:VK_MEMORY_ALLOCATE_DEVICE_ADDRESS_CAPTURE_REPLAY_BIT specifies
that the memory's address can: be saved and reused on a subsequent run
(e.g. for trace capture and replay), see
slink:VkBufferOpaqueCaptureAddressCreateInfo for more detail.
If this bit is set, ename:VK_MEMORY_ALLOCATE_DEVICE_ADDRESS_BIT must:
also be set.

items.name: VK_MEMORY_ALLOCATE_ZERO_INITIALIZE_BIT_EXT
items.text:
ename:VK_MEMORY_ALLOCATE_ZERO_INITIALIZE_BIT_EXT specifies that the
memory will be zeroed automatically by the implementation before
application is able to access it.

items.text:

overallocation is allowed if platform permits.

items.text:
ename:VK_MEMORY_OVERALLOCATION_BEHAVIOR_DISALLOWED_AMD specifies the
application is not allowed to allocate device memory beyond the heap
sizes reported by slink:VkPhysicalDeviceMemoryProperties.
Allocations that are not explicitly made by the application within the
scope of the Vulkan instance are not accounted for.

the priority of the allocation relative to other memory allocations.
Larger values are higher priority.
The granularity of the priorities is implementation-dependent.

pages.desc: Bitmask specifying properties for a memory type

items.name: VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_DEVICE_LOCAL_BIT
items.text:
ename:VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_DEVICE_LOCAL_BIT bit specifies that memory
allocated with this type is the most efficient for device access.
This property will be set if and only if the memory type belongs to a
heap with the ename:VK_MEMORY_HEAP_DEVICE_LOCAL_BIT set.

items.name: VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_VISIBLE_BIT
items.text:
ename:VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_VISIBLE_BIT bit specifies that memory
allocated with this type can: be mapped for host access using
flink:vkMapMemory.

items.name: VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_COHERENT_BIT
items.text:
ename:VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_COHERENT_BIT bit
specifies that the host cache management commands
flink:vkFlushMappedMemoryRanges and flink:vkInvalidateMappedMemoryRanges
are not needed to manage
<<synchronization-dependencies-available-and-visible, availability and
visibility>> on the host.

items.name: VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_CACHED_BIT
items.text:
ename:VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_CACHED_BIT bit specifies that memory
allocated with this type is cached on the host.
Host memory read accesses to uncached memory are slower than to cached
memory, however uncached memory is always host coherent.

items.name: VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_LAZILY_ALLOCATED_BIT
items.text:
ename:VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_LAZILY_ALLOCATED_BIT bit specifies that the
memory type only allows device access to the memory.
Memory types must: not have both
ename:VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_LAZILY_ALLOCATED_BIT and
ename:VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_VISIBLE_BIT set.
Additionally, the object's backing memory may: be provided by the
implementation lazily as specified in <<memory-device-lazy_allocation,
Lazily Allocated Memory>>.

items.name: VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_PROTECTED_BIT
items.text:
ename:VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_PROTECTED_BIT bit specifies that the memory
type only allows device access to the memory, and allows protected queue
operations to access the memory.
Memory types must: not have ename:VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_PROTECTED_BIT set
and any of ename:VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_VISIBLE_BIT set, or
ename:VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_COHERENT_BIT set, or
ename:VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_CACHED_BIT set.

items.name: VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_DEVICE_COHERENT_BIT_AMD
items.text:
ename:VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_DEVICE_COHERENT_BIT_AMD bit specifies that
device accesses to allocations of this memory type are automatically
made <<synchronization-dependencies-available-and-visible, available and
visible>> on the device.
If paired with ename:VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_COHERENT_BIT,
<<synchronization-dependencies-available-and-visible, memory domain
operations>> are also performed automatically between host and device.

items.name: VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_DEVICE_UNCACHED_BIT_AMD
items.text:
ename:VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_DEVICE_UNCACHED_BIT_AMD bit specifies that
memory allocated with this type is not cached on the device.
Uncached device memory is always device coherent.

items.name: VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_RDMA_CAPABLE_BIT_NV
items.text:
ename:VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_RDMA_CAPABLE_BIT_NV bit specifies that external
devices can access this memory directly.

items.text:
ename:VK_MEMORY_UNMAP_RESERVE_BIT_EXT requests that virtual address
range currently occupied by the memory map remain reserved after the
flink:vkUnmapMemory2 call completes.
Future system memory map operations or calls to flink:vkMapMemory or
flink:vkMapMemory2 will not return addresses in that range unless the
range has since been unreserved by the client or the mapping is
explicitly placed in that range by calling flink:vkMapMemory2 with
ename:VK_MEMORY_MAP_PLACED_BIT_EXT, or doing the system memory map
equivalent.

operation may: fail, in which case the memory object will remain host
mapped and flink:vkUnmapMemory2 will return
ename:VK_ERROR_MEMORY_MAP_FAILED.

that temporal hints from previously generated flow vectors are not used.

ename:VK_OPTICAL_FLOW_SESSION_BINDING_POINT_INPUT_NV specifies the
binding point for the input frame.

items.name: VK_OPTICAL_FLOW_SESSION_BINDING_POINT_REFERENCE_NV
items.text:
ename:VK_OPTICAL_FLOW_SESSION_BINDING_POINT_REFERENCE_NV specifies the
binding point for the input reference frame.

items.name: VK_OPTICAL_FLOW_SESSION_BINDING_POINT_HINT_NV
items.text:
ename:VK_OPTICAL_FLOW_SESSION_BINDING_POINT_HINT_NV specifies the
binding point for the optional external hint flow vectors.

items.name: VK_OPTICAL_FLOW_SESSION_BINDING_POINT_FLOW_VECTOR_NV
items.text:
ename:VK_OPTICAL_FLOW_SESSION_BINDING_POINT_FLOW_VECTOR_NV specifies the
binding point for output flow vectors of default forward flow
calculation.

items.name: VK_OPTICAL_FLOW_SESSION_BINDING_POINT_BACKWARD_FLOW_VECTOR_NV
items.text:
ename:VK_OPTICAL_FLOW_SESSION_BINDING_POINT_BACKWARD_FLOW_VECTOR_NV
specifies the binding point for the optional output flow vector map of
optional backward flow calculation.

items.name: VK_OPTICAL_FLOW_SESSION_BINDING_POINT_COST_NV
items.text:
ename:VK_OPTICAL_FLOW_SESSION_BINDING_POINT_COST_NV specifies the
binding point for the optional output cost map of default forward flow
calculation.

items.name: VK_OPTICAL_FLOW_SESSION_BINDING_POINT_BACKWARD_COST_NV
items.text:
ename:VK_OPTICAL_FLOW_SESSION_BINDING_POINT_BACKWARD_COST_NV specifies
the binding point for the optional output cost map of optional backward
flow calculation.

items.name: VK_OPTICAL_FLOW_SESSION_BINDING_POINT_GLOBAL_FLOW_NV
items.text:
ename:VK_OPTICAL_FLOW_SESSION_BINDING_POINT_GLOBAL_FLOW_NV specifies the
binding point for the optional global flow value of default forward flow
calculation.

pages.name: VkOpticalFlowSessionBindingPointNV

pages.desc: Bits specifying flags for optical flow session

items.name: VK_OPTICAL_FLOW_SESSION_CREATE_ENABLE_HINT_BIT_NV
items.text:
ename:VK_OPTICAL_FLOW_SESSION_CREATE_ENABLE_HINT_BIT_NV specifies that a
slink:VkImageView with external flow vectors will be used as hints in
performing the motion search and must: be bound to
ename:VK_OPTICAL_FLOW_SESSION_BINDING_POINT_HINT_NV.

items.name: VK_OPTICAL_FLOW_SESSION_CREATE_ENABLE_COST_BIT_NV
items.text:
ename:VK_OPTICAL_FLOW_SESSION_CREATE_ENABLE_COST_BIT_NV specifies that
the cost for the forward flow is generated in a slink:VkImageView which
must: be bound to ename:VK_OPTICAL_FLOW_SESSION_BINDING_POINT_COST_NV.
Additionally, if
ename:VK_OPTICAL_FLOW_SESSION_CREATE_BOTH_DIRECTIONS_BIT_NV is also set,
the cost for backward flow is generated in a slink:VkImageView which
must: be bound to
ename:VK_OPTICAL_FLOW_SESSION_BINDING_POINT_BACKWARD_COST_NV.
The cost is the confidence level of the flow vector for each grid in the
frame.
The Cost implies how (in)accurate the flow vector is.
Higher cost value implies the flow vector to be less accurate and
vice-versa.

items.name: VK_OPTICAL_FLOW_SESSION_CREATE_ENABLE_GLOBAL_FLOW_BIT_NV
items.text:
ename:VK_OPTICAL_FLOW_SESSION_CREATE_ENABLE_GLOBAL_FLOW_BIT_NV specifies
that a global flow vector is estimated from forward flow in a single
pixel slink:VkImageView which must: be bound to
ename:VK_OPTICAL_FLOW_SESSION_BINDING_POINT_GLOBAL_FLOW_NV.

items.name: VK_OPTICAL_FLOW_SESSION_CREATE_ALLOW_REGIONS_BIT_NV
items.text:
ename:VK_OPTICAL_FLOW_SESSION_CREATE_ALLOW_REGIONS_BIT_NV specifies that
regions of interest can: be specified in
slink:VkOpticalFlowExecuteInfoNV.

items.name: VK_OPTICAL_FLOW_SESSION_CREATE_BOTH_DIRECTIONS_BIT_NV
items.text:
ename:VK_OPTICAL_FLOW_SESSION_CREATE_BOTH_DIRECTIONS_BIT_NV specifies
that backward flow is generated in addition to forward flow which is
always generated.

pages.desc: Structure specifying parameters of a newly created optical flow session

items.name: sType
items.text: pname:sType is a elink:VkStructureType value identifying this structure.

items.name: pNext
items.text:
pname:pNext is `NULL` or a pointer to a structure extending this
structure.

items.name: width
items.text:
pname:width is the width in pixels of the input or reference frame to be
bound to this optical flow session.

items.name: height
items.text:
pname:height is the height in pixels of the input or reference frame to
be bound to this optical flow session.

items.name: imageFormat
items.text:
pname:imageFormat is the elink:VkFormat of the input and reference frame
to be bound to this optical flow session.

items.name: flowVectorFormat
items.text:
pname:flowVectorFormat is the elink:VkFormat of the flow vector maps
(output or hint) to be bound to this optical flow session.

items.name: costFormat
items.text:
pname:costFormat is the elink:VkFormat of the cost maps to be bound to
this optical flow session.

items.name: outputGridSize
items.text:
pname:outputGridSize is exactly one bit of
tlink:VkOpticalFlowGridSizeFlagsNV specifying the grid size of the
output flow and cost maps to be bound to this optical flow session.
The size of the output flow and cost maps is determined by
sname:VkOpticalFlowSessionCreateInfoNV::pname:width and
sname:VkOpticalFlowSessionCreateInfoNV::pname:height divided by
sname:VkOpticalFlowSessionCreateInfoNV::pname:outputGridSize.

items.name: hintGridSize
items.text:
pname:hintGridSize is one exactly bit of
tlink:VkOpticalFlowGridSizeFlagsNV specifying the grid size of the hint
flow vector maps to be bound to this optical flow session.
The size of the hint maps is determined by
sname:VkOpticalFlowSessionCreateInfoNV::pname:width and
sname:VkOpticalFlowSessionCreateInfoNV::pname:height divided by
sname:VkOpticalFlowSessionCreateInfoNV::pname:hintGridSize.

items.name: performanceLevel
items.text:
pname:performanceLevel is the elink:VkOpticalFlowPerformanceLevelNV used
for this optical flow session.

items.name: flags
items.text:
pname:flags are the tlink:VkOpticalFlowSessionCreateFlagsNV used for
this optical flow session.

be used as input or reference frame for an optical flow operation.

ename:VK_OPTICAL_FLOW_USAGE_OUTPUT_BIT_NV specifies that the image can:

items.name: VK_OPTICAL_FLOW_USAGE_HINT_BIT_NV

items.name: VK_OPTICAL_FLOW_USAGE_COST_BIT_NV

ename:VK_OPTICAL_FLOW_USAGE_COST_BIT_NV specifies that the image can: be

items.name: VK_OPTICAL_FLOW_USAGE_GLOBAL_FLOW_BIT_NV

ename:VK_OPTICAL_FLOW_USAGE_GLOBAL_FLOW_BIT_NV specifies that the image
can: be used as global flow vector for an optical flow operation.

pages.name: VkPartitionedAccelerationStructureFlagsNV

pages.desc: Bitmask specifying flags for PTLAS instances

items.name: VK_PARTITIONED_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_INSTANCE_FLAG_TRIANGLE_FACING_CULL_DISABLE_BIT_NV
items.text:
ename:VK_PARTITIONED_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_INSTANCE_FLAG_TRIANGLE_FACING_CULL_DISABLE_BIT_NV
disables face culling for this instance.

items.name: VK_PARTITIONED_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_INSTANCE_FLAG_TRIANGLE_FLIP_FACING_BIT_NV
items.text:
ename:VK_PARTITIONED_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_INSTANCE_FLAG_TRIANGLE_FLIP_FACING_BIT_NV
specifies that the <<ray-traversal-culling-face, facing determination>>
for geometry in this instance is inverted.

items.name: VK_PARTITIONED_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_INSTANCE_FLAG_FORCE_OPAQUE_BIT_NV
items.text:
ename:VK_PARTITIONED_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_INSTANCE_FLAG_FORCE_OPAQUE_BIT_NV
causes this instance to act as though ename:VK_GEOMETRY_OPAQUE_BIT_KHR
were specified on all geometries referenced by this instance.

items.name: VK_PARTITIONED_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_INSTANCE_FLAG_FORCE_NO_OPAQUE_BIT_NV
items.text:
ename:VK_PARTITIONED_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_INSTANCE_FLAG_FORCE_NO_OPAQUE_BIT_NV
causes this instance to act as though ename:VK_GEOMETRY_OPAQUE_BIT_KHR
were not specified on all geometries referenced by this instance.

items.name: VK_PARTITIONED_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_INSTANCE_FLAG_ENABLE_EXPLICIT_BOUNDING_BOX_NV
items.text:
ename:VK_PARTITIONED_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_INSTANCE_FLAG_ENABLE_EXPLICIT_BOUNDING_BOX_NV
enables use of an explicit bounding box for this instance.

items.name: sType

items.name: pNext

pname:pNext is `NULL` or a pointer to a structure extending this
structure.

pname:flags is a bitmask of tlink:VkBuildAccelerationStructureFlagsKHR
specifying flags for the PTLAS build operation.

items.name: instanceCount
items.text: pname:instanceCount is the number of instances in this PTLAS.

items.name: maxInstancePerPartitionCount
items.text:
pname:maxInstancePerPartitionCount is the maximum number of instances
per partition in the PTLAS.

items.name: partitionCount
items.text: pname:partitionCount is the number of partitions in the PTLAS.

items.name: maxInstanceInGlobalPartitionCount

pname:maxInstanceInGlobalPartitionCount is maximum number of instances
in the <<ptlas-global-partition, global partition>>.

pages.name: VkPartitionedAccelerationStructureInstancesInputNV

pages.desc: Enum providing the type of PTLAS operation to perform

items.name: VK_PARTITIONED_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_OP_TYPE_WRITE_INSTANCE_NV
items.text:
ename:VK_PARTITIONED_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_OP_TYPE_WRITE_INSTANCE_NV is
used to assign a transformed bottom level acceleration structure to an
instance and partition.
This is similar to slink:VkAccelerationStructureInstanceKHR that defines
the properties and transformations for a single instance in
non-partitioned TLAS.
Any partition that contains at least one of the affected instances will
have their internal acceleration structure rebuilt.

items.name: VK_PARTITIONED_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_OP_TYPE_UPDATE_INSTANCE_NV
items.text:
ename:VK_PARTITIONED_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_OP_TYPE_UPDATE_INSTANCE_NV
specifies that an instance will be updated with a new bottom level
acceleration structure.

items.name: VK_PARTITIONED_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_OP_TYPE_WRITE_PARTITION_TRANSLATION_NV
items.text:
ename:VK_PARTITIONED_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_OP_TYPE_WRITE_PARTITION_TRANSLATION_NV
specifies that a partition will be assigned a
<<ptlas-partition-translation, translation vector>>.

pages.name: VkPartitionedAccelerationStructureOpTypeNV

pages.desc: Structure describing instance data to update in PTLAS

items.name: instanceIndex
items.text: pname:instanceIndex is the index of the instance being updated.

items.name: instanceContributionToHitGroupIndex
items.text:
pname:instanceContributionToHitGroupIndex is a 24-bit per instance value
added in the indexing into the shader binding table to fetch the hit
group to use.

items.name: accelerationStructure
items.text:
pname:accelerationStructure is the device address of the bottom level
acceleration structure or a clustered bottom level acceleration
structure whose instance is being updated.
The instance is disabled if the device address is `0`.

pages.name: VkPartitionedAccelerationStructureUpdateInstanceDataNV

pages.desc: Structure describing instance data to write in PTLAS

items.name: transform
items.text:
pname:transform is a slink:VkTransformMatrixKHR structure describing the
transformation to be applied to the instance in PTLAS.

items.name: explicitAABB
items.text:
pname:explicitAABB specifies an axis aligned bounding box representing
the maximum extent of any vertex within the used acceleration structure
after applying the instance-to-world transformation.
The <<ptlas-partition-translation, partition translation>> is not
applied to the bounding box.

items.name: instanceID
items.text:
pname:instanceID is a user specified constant assigned to an instance in
the PTLAS.

items.name: instanceMask
items.text:
pname:instanceMask is a 8-bit mask assigned to the instance that may: be
used to include or reject group of instances.

items.name: instanceContributionToHitGroupIndex
items.text:
pname:instanceContributionToHitGroupIndex is a 24-bit per application
specified instance value added in the indexing into the shader binding
table to fetch the hit group to use.

items.name: instanceFlags
items.text:
pname:instanceFlags is a bitmask of
tlink:VkPartitionedAccelerationStructureInstanceFlagsNV specifying flags
an instance in the PTLAS.

items.name: instanceIndex
items.text: pname:instanceIndex is the index of the instance within the PTLAS.

items.name: partitionIndex
items.text:
pname:partitionIndex is the index of the partition to which this
instance belongs.
<<ptlas-global-partition, Global partitions>> are referred to by
ename:VK_PARTITIONED_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_PARTITION_INDEX_GLOBAL_NV.

items.name: accelerationStructure
items.text:
pname:accelerationStructure is the device address of the bottom level
acceleration structure or a clustered bottom level acceleration
structure that is being instanced.
This instance is disabled if the device address is `0`.

pages.name: VkPartitionedAccelerationStructureWriteInstanceDataNV

pages.desc: Structure describing partition translation data to write in PTLAS

items.name: partitionIndex
items.text:
pname:partitionIndex is the index of partition to write.
<<ptlas-global-partition, Global partition>> is referred to by
ename:VK_PARTITIONED_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_PARTITION_INDEX_GLOBAL_NV.

items.name: partitionTranslation
items.text:
pname:partitionTranslation sets the <<ptlas-partition-translation,
translation vector>> for this partition.
When tracing this partition, the contained instances will behave as if
the partition translation was added to the translation component of the
instance transform.
This translation vector is also added to the instances in the partition
that had their bounding box specified.

pages.desc: Structure containing timing information about a previously-presented image

items.name: sType
items.text: pname:sType is a elink:VkStructureType value identifying this structure.

items.name: pNext
items.text:
pname:pNext is `NULL` or a pointer to a structure extending this
structure.

items.name: presentId
items.text:
pname:presentId is zero or a value that was given to a previous
fname:vkQueuePresentKHR command via
slink:VkPresentId2KHR::pname:pPresentIds.

items.name: targetTime
items.text:
pname:targetTime is the application-provided target absolute time or
duration of the associated presentation request in
slink:VkPresentTimingInfoEXT::pname:targetTime.

items.name: presentStageCount
items.text:
pname:presentStageCount is a count of items contained in
pname:pPresentStages.

items.name: pPresentStages
items.text:
pname:pPresentStages a pointer to an array of
slink:VkPresentStageTimeEXT providing timing information for the
presentation request associated with pname:presentId.

items.name: timeDomain
items.text:
pname:timeDomain is the time domain used by the presentation engine to
report times in pname:pPresentStages.

items.name: timeDomainId
items.text: pname:timeDomainId is the id associated with pname:timeDomain.

items.name: reportComplete
items.text:
pname:reportComplete is ename:VK_TRUE if the presentation engine has
reported all the requested results in pname:pPresentStages.

pages.desc: Bitmask specifying past presentation timing query flags

items.name: VK_PAST_PRESENTATION_TIMING_ALLOW_PARTIAL_RESULTS_BIT_EXT
items.text:
ename:VK_PAST_PRESENTATION_TIMING_ALLOW_PARTIAL_RESULTS_BIT_EXT
specifies that flink:vkGetPastPresentationTimingEXT may: return partial
results for presentation requests that have not completed all requested
present stages.

items.name: VK_PAST_PRESENTATION_TIMING_ALLOW_OUT_OF_ORDER_RESULTS_BIT_EXT
items.text:
ename:VK_PAST_PRESENTATION_TIMING_ALLOW_OUT_OF_ORDER_RESULTS_BIT_EXT
specifies that flink:vkGetPastPresentationTimingEXT may: return results
out of order with respect to the presentation order.

pages.name: VkPastPresentationTimingFlagBitsEXT

pages.desc: Bitmask of VkPastPresentationTimingFlagBitsEXT
pages.name: VkPastPresentationTimingFlagsEXT

pages.desc: Structure containing timing information about a previously-presented image

items.name: presentID
items.text:
pname:presentID is an application-provided value that was given to a
previous fname:vkQueuePresentKHR command via
slink:VkPresentTimeGOOGLE::pname:presentID (see below).
It can: be used to uniquely identify a previous present with the
flink:vkQueuePresentKHR command.

items.name: desiredPresentTime
items.text:
pname:desiredPresentTime is an application-provided value that was given
to a previous flink:vkQueuePresentKHR command via
slink:VkPresentTimeGOOGLE::pname:desiredPresentTime.
If non-zero, it was used by the application to indicate that an image
not be presented any sooner than pname:desiredPresentTime.

items.name: actualPresentTime
items.text:
pname:actualPresentTime is the time when the image of the
pname:swapchain was actually displayed.

items.name: earliestPresentTime
items.text:
pname:earliestPresentTime is the time when the image of the
pname:swapchain could have been displayed.
This may: differ from pname:actualPresentTime if the application
requested that the image be presented no sooner than
slink:VkPresentTimeGOOGLE::pname:desiredPresentTime.

items.name: presentMargin
items.text:
pname:presentMargin is an indication of how early the
fname:vkQueuePresentKHR command was processed compared to how soon it
needed to be processed, and still be presented at
pname:earliestPresentTime.

items.name: sType

items.name: storageBuffer16BitAccess
items.text:
pname:storageBuffer16BitAccess specifies whether objects in the
code:StorageBuffer,
code:ShaderRecordBufferKHR,
or code:PhysicalStorageBuffer
storage class with the code:Block decoration can: have 16-bit integer
and 16-bit floating-point members.
If this feature is not enabled, 16-bit integer or 16-bit floating-point
members must: not be used in such
objects unless the <<features-storageBuffer8BitAccess,
pname:storageBuffer8BitAccess>> or
<<features-uniformAndStorageBuffer8BitAccess,
pname:uniformAndStorageBuffer8BitAccess>> features are enabled or they
are accessed in 32-bit multiples if the
<<features-shaderUntypedPointers, pname:shaderUntypedPointers>> feature
is enabled.
This also specifies whether shader modules can: declare the
code:StorageBuffer16BitAccess capability.

items.name: uniformAndStorageBuffer16BitAccess
items.text:
pname:uniformAndStorageBuffer16BitAccess specifies whether objects in
the code:Uniform storage class with the code:Block decoration can: have
16-bit integer and 16-bit floating-point members.
If this feature is not enabled, 16-bit integer or 16-bit floating-point
members must: not be used in such
objects unless the
<<features-uniformAndStorageBuffer8BitAccess,
pname:uniformAndStorageBuffer8BitAccess>> are enabled or they are
accessed in 32-bit multiples if the <<features-shaderUntypedPointers,
pname:shaderUntypedPointers>> feature is enabled.
This also specifies whether shader modules can: declare the
code:UniformAndStorageBuffer16BitAccess capability.

items.name: storagePushConstant16
items.text:
pname:storagePushConstant16 specifies whether objects in the
code:PushConstant storage class can: have 16-bit integer and 16-bit
floating-point members.
If this feature is not enabled, 16-bit integer or floating-point members
must: not be used in such
objects unless the <<features-storagePushConstant8,
pname:storagePushConstant8>> feature is enabled or they are accessed in
32-bit multiples if the <<features-shaderUntypedPointers,
pname:shaderUntypedPointers>> feature is enabled.
This also specifies whether shader modules can: declare the
code:StoragePushConstant16 capability.

items.name: storageInputOutput16
items.text:
pname:storageInputOutput16 specifies whether objects in the code:Input
and code:Output storage classes can: have 16-bit integer and 16-bit
floating-point members.
If this feature is not enabled, 16-bit integer or 16-bit floating-point
members must: not be used in such objects.
This also specifies whether shader modules can: declare the
code:StorageInputOutput16 capability.

shader stage in a pipeline layout.
Descriptor bindings with a descriptor type of
ename:VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_KHR count against this
limit.
Only descriptor bindings in descriptor set layouts created without the
ename:VK_DESCRIPTOR_SET_LAYOUT_CREATE_UPDATE_AFTER_BIND_POOL_BIT bit set
count against this limit.

items.name: maxPerStageDescriptorUpdateAfterBindAccelerationStructures
items.text:
pname:maxPerStageDescriptorUpdateAfterBindAccelerationStructures is
similar to pname:maxPerStageDescriptorAccelerationStructures but counts
descriptor bindings from descriptor sets created with or without the
ename:VK_DESCRIPTOR_SET_LAYOUT_CREATE_UPDATE_AFTER_BIND_POOL_BIT bit
set.

items.name: maxDescriptorSetAccelerationStructures
items.text:

acceleration structure descriptors that can: be included in descriptor
bindings in a pipeline layout across all pipeline shader stages and
descriptor set numbers.
Descriptor bindings with a descriptor type of
ename:VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE_KHR count against this
limit.
Only descriptor bindings in descriptor set layouts created without the
ename:VK_DESCRIPTOR_SET_LAYOUT_CREATE_UPDATE_AFTER_BIND_POOL_BIT bit set
count against this limit.

items.name: maxDescriptorSetUpdateAfterBindAccelerationStructures
items.text:
pname:maxDescriptorSetUpdateAfterBindAccelerationStructures is similar
to pname:maxDescriptorSetAccelerationStructures but counts descriptor
bindings from descriptor sets created with or without the
ename:VK_DESCRIPTOR_SET_LAYOUT_CREATE_UPDATE_AFTER_BIND_POOL_BIT bit
set.

items.text:

pages.desc: Structure describing conservative raster properties that can be supported by an implementation

items.name: sType
items.text: pname:sType is a elink:VkStructureType value identifying this structure.

items.name: pNext
items.text:
pname:pNext is `NULL` or a pointer to a structure extending this
structure.

items.name: primitiveOverestimationSize
items.text:
pname:primitiveOverestimationSize
is the size in pixels the generating primitive is increased at each of
its edges during conservative rasterization overestimation mode.
Even with a size of 0.0, conservative rasterization overestimation rules
still apply and if any part of the pixel rectangle is covered by the
generating primitive, fragments are generated for the entire pixel.
However implementations may: make the pixel coverage area even more
conservative by increasing the size of the generating primitive.

items.name: maxExtraPrimitiveOverestimationSize
items.text:
pname:maxExtraPrimitiveOverestimationSize is the maximum size in pixels
of extra overestimation the implementation supports in the pipeline
state.
A value of 0.0 means the implementation does not support any additional
overestimation of the generating primitive during conservative
rasterization.
A value above 0.0 allows the application to further increase the size of
the generating primitive during conservative rasterization
overestimation.

items.name: extraPrimitiveOverestimationSizeGranularity
items.text:
pname:extraPrimitiveOverestimationSizeGranularity is the granularity of
extra overestimation that can be specified in the pipeline state between
0.0 and pname:maxExtraPrimitiveOverestimationSize inclusive.
A value of 0.0 means the implementation can use the smallest
representable non-zero value in the screen space pixel fixed-point grid.

items.name: primitiveUnderestimation
items.text:
pname:primitiveUnderestimation is
ename:VK_TRUE if the implementation supports the
ename:VK_CONSERVATIVE_RASTERIZATION_MODE_UNDERESTIMATE_EXT conservative
rasterization mode in addition to
ename:VK_CONSERVATIVE_RASTERIZATION_MODE_OVERESTIMATE_EXT.
Otherwise the implementation only supports
ename:VK_CONSERVATIVE_RASTERIZATION_MODE_OVERESTIMATE_EXT.

items.name: conservativePointAndLineRasterization
items.text:
pname:conservativePointAndLineRasterization is ename:VK_TRUE if the
implementation supports conservative rasterization of point and line
primitives as well as triangle primitives.
Otherwise the implementation only supports triangle primitives.

items.name: degenerateTrianglesRasterized
items.text:
pname:degenerateTrianglesRasterized is ename:VK_FALSE if the
implementation culls primitives generated from triangles that become
zero area after they are quantized to the fixed-point rasterization
pixel grid.
pname:degenerateTrianglesRasterized is ename:VK_TRUE if these primitives
are not culled and the provoking vertex attributes and depth value are
used for the fragments.
The primitive area calculation is done on the primitive generated from
the clipped triangle if applicable.
Zero area primitives are backfacing and the application can: enable
backface culling if desired.

items.name: degenerateLinesRasterized
items.text:
pname:degenerateLinesRasterized is
ename:VK_FALSE if the implementation culls lines that become zero length
after they are quantized to the fixed-point rasterization pixel grid.
pname:degenerateLinesRasterized is ename:VK_TRUE if zero length lines
are not culled and the provoking vertex attributes and depth value are
used for the fragments.

items.name: fullyCoveredFragmentShaderInputVariable
items.text:
pname:fullyCoveredFragmentShaderInputVariable is ename:VK_TRUE if the
implementation supports the SPIR-V builtin fragment shader input
variable code:FullyCoveredEXT specifying that conservative rasterization
is enabled and the fragment area is fully covered by the generating
primitive.

items.name: conservativeRasterizationPostDepthCoverage
items.text:
pname:conservativeRasterizationPostDepthCoverage is ename:VK_TRUE if the
implementation supports conservative rasterization with the
code:PostDepthCoverage execution mode enabled.
Otherwise the code:PostDepthCoverage execution mode must: not be used
when conservative rasterization is enabled.

ename:VK_RESOLVE_MODE_AVERAGE_BIT must: not be included in the set.

items.name: independentResolveNone
items.text:
pname:independentResolveNone is ename:VK_TRUE if the implementation
supports setting the depth and stencil resolve modes to different values
when one of those modes is ename:VK_RESOLVE_MODE_NONE.
Otherwise the implementation only supports setting both modes to the
same value.

items.name: independentResolve
items.text:
pname:independentResolve
is ename:VK_TRUE if the implementation supports all combinations of the
supported depth and stencil resolve modes, including setting either
depth or stencil resolve mode to ename:VK_RESOLVE_MODE_NONE.
An implementation that supports pname:independentResolve must: also
support pname:independentResolveNone.

items.name: sType

in memory.

items.text:
pname:descriptorBufferCaptureReplay indicates that the implementation
supports capture and replay when using descriptor buffers.
If this is ename:VK_TRUE, all resources created with
ename:VK_BUFFER_CREATE_DESCRIPTOR_BUFFER_CAPTURE_REPLAY_BIT_EXT,
ename:VK_IMAGE_CREATE_DESCRIPTOR_BUFFER_CAPTURE_REPLAY_BIT_EXT,

items.name: descriptorBufferImageLayoutIgnored

items.name: descriptorBufferPushDescriptors

supports using push descriptors with descriptor buffers.

items.name: sType
